jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering Management
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers focused on delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that improve how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive experiences, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer plays an important role in shaping the quality, reliability, and long-term success of our products.

About The Team

The Service Operations Business Unit brings together IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and CMDB capabilities on the ServiceNow Platform. This product engineering organization builds the software that helps customers deliver resilient, intelligent, and efficient enterprise services.

The Service Operations product portfolio connects incident, request, fulfillment, infrastructure visibility, service mapping, trusted configuration data, automation, and AIOps into a unified operating model. By combining service delivery with operational intelligence and trusted operational context, these products help customers move toward proactive, AI-assisted, and increasingly self-healing operations at enterprise scale.

Together, these capabilities help customers modernize how they deliver and operate services, improve reliability, reduce manual effort, and drive measurable productivity outcomes on a single platform.

What You Get To Do In This Role

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams that architect and build assistive and autonomous AI-native products to usher customers (IT departments using our IT service and operations management applications) into an agentic-first era. The work will span large-scale distributed systems, data ingestion, context creation and utilization, agentic harnesses, cost optimization, and agentic feedback loops to ensure value realization for our customers.

This role requires people leadership, thought leadership, deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a keen understanding of the scientific method to ship and refine real product through iterative experimentation. You will be accountable for the growth, health, and delivery outcomes of your teams.

Responsibilities Include

Lead and grow the engineering teams responsible for assigned problem areas within ITSM/ITOM products, working with product and engineering leaders to understand blockers and opportunities around AI-native evolution and value realization.
Own technical strategy and delivery for your teams. Set architectural direction, hold the bar on quality and reliability, and stay close enough to the work to validate hypotheses through evidence, not theory.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers, tech leads, and managers. Build inclusive, high-performing teams with clear career paths and durable ownership.
Drive evidence-based decision-making: formulate hypotheses, run experiments, measure outcomes, and use data to guide architectural decisions and product direction.
Lead the evolution of current solutions toward AI-native capabilities—identifying where agentic patterns, data utilization, or autonomous workflows can unlock customer value—and translate those recommendations into staffed, executable work.
Identify and address value realization gaps in agentic products that exist but aren’t delivering expected outcomes. Diagnose root causes (architecture, UX, data quality, feedback loops, cost) and direct targeted improvements.
Establish architecture patterns, engineering standards, and operating rhythms specific to your problem domain. Document tradeoffs, rationale, and implementation guidance to help teams move faster and make consistent decisions.
Collaborate across ITSM/ITOM engineering teams to share learnings, validate approaches, and accelerate adoption of patterns that work.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success — aligning on roadmap and release readiness, meeting security and compliance requirements, and feeding field and customer signal back into engineering priorities.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

15+ years of related engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams (including managers or team leads), or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, enterprise platforms, workflow systems, data-intensive products, integration frameworks, or cloud-scale infrastructure.
Deep understanding of system design for scale, reliability, observability, fault tolerance, data quality, security, and production readiness.
Strong technical depth in Java, Python, or similar programming languages.
Proven ability to define technical direction, influence architecture across teams, and translate ambiguous product strategy into executable engineering plans.
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineers and engineering leaders, and managing performance, career growth, and team health.
Ability to lead through formal authority and technical credibility alike, building alignment across peer engineering, Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.
Strong judgment in balancing long-term architecture with pragmatic execution, customer impact, engineering velocity, and business priorities.
Experience mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and building reusable patterns that create leverage across teams.
Experience with AI-powered products, automation platforms, AI-assisted workflows, or agentic systems is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about AI-assisted enterprise workflows, including data quality, workflow correctness, evaluation, observability, safety controls, and human-in-the-loop review.
Experience with enterprise service management, IT operations, CMDB, discovery, service mapping, AIOps, observability, workflow automation, endpoint management, or operational intelligence is a strong plus.
Experience working with large-scale enterprise customers, production systems, and complex migration or modernization efforts is a plus.
Why Join Us
Shape the AI-native future of the Service Operations Business Unit product portfolio on the ServiceNow Platform.
Build and lead the teams delivering foundational product and platform capabilities that help enterprises deliver, operate, automate, and continuously improve services at scale.
Define how AI agents, automation, operational data, and human workflows come together to create safer, more reliable, and more productive enterprise operations.
Collaborate with teams that value craftsmanship, quality, innovation, accountability, and meaningful customer impact.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

THE ROLE: 

As a Senior Manager, System Memory Validation Engineering, you will lead a team responsible for ensuring the performance, reliability, and quality of AMD's next-generation memory solutions. You will drive system memory validation strategy from pre-silicon development through customer deployment, working closely with architecture, silicon design, firmware, BIOS, and validation teams. This role combines deep technical leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and people management to enable industry-leading server, AI, and high-performance computing platforms.

THE PERSON: 

The successful candidate is a seasoned engineering leader with deep system memory expertise and a demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex validation, bring-up, and product enablement challenges. They combine strong technical depth across hardware, firmware, and system software with exceptional leadership, strategic thinking, and a commitment to developing talent and delivering customer success.

Key Responsibilities

Lead a hardworking distributed team passionate about delivering robust technical solutions including pre-silicon and post-silicon work. 
Own the team to innovate methods for pre-silicon memory validation and efficiencies for post silicon memory bring up, feature enablement, optimization, and validation. 
Lead system memory validation strategy from pre-silicon through customer adoption working across architecture, silicon design, firmware, validation, and debug teams.
Proactively leading project planning, developing, and maintaining schedules, managing dependencies, and ensuring quality of work you are doing at committed landmarks. 
Working directly with our customers to ensure their memory solutions meet industry best requirements.
Drive debug and resolution of system memory issues across silicon, firmware/BIOS, and coordinating with memory partners as needed. 
Drive communication of program status, key milestones, risks, and deliverables to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
Build and develop a high-performing team through coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership.

Preferred Experience

Expertise in system memory technologies, including DDR, LPDDR, HBM, and memory subsystem architecture.
Strong experience with pre-silicon and post-silicon memory validation, bring-up, debug, and performance optimization.
Deep understanding of firmware, BIOS/UEFI, and system software interactions with memory subsystems.
Engineering leadership experience managing teams and driving cross-functional execution across hardware and software organizations.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.

Academic Credentials

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in related discipline preferred

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering Redshift, Analytics Engines
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Redshift is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the Redshift Engine Team, a global organization spanning the United States and Europe. Amazon Redshift is the most widely used cloud data warehouse, powering SQL analytics on unified data across Redshift Managed Storage and open data lakes for tens of thousands of customers worldwide. The team's vision: build the best SQL analytics engine for humans and agents over any data.

This is a rare opportunity to lead at the intersection of analytics, AI, and distributed systems at a massive scale. The team owns the core query processing engine optimization, high-performance execution, catalog, Exabytes of managed storage, and leading-edge autonomics and is innovating across serverless scale-up/scale-out, automated cluster management, AI-driven scaling, zero-ETL integrations, an integrated data lake query engine, and natural-language analytics via Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases.

As Director, you will own the technical strategy and execution for the engine, shape how AI agents interact with Redshift for intelligent query generation and optimization-aware execution, lead a globally distributed organization, and drive cross-organizational collaboration with partner services including Glue Data Catalog, EMR, Athena, and SageMaker Unified Studio.

Key job responsibilities

Define and drive the long-term technical vision for the Redshift query engine as the industry-leading SQL analytics engine for human users and AI agents alike including how autonomous and agentic workloads interact with the engine for intelligent query generation and optimization-aware execution.
Lead and grow a globally distributed engineering organization across the US and Europe, fostering a culture of operational excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Own the architecture and roadmap for query optimization, high-performance execution, scalable catalog, cost-based planning, storage, and self-tuning systems including next-generation solutions for transactional data warehousing and elastic query processing over open-format data at scale.
Drive cross-organizational collaboration across partner services (Glue Data Catalog, EMR, Glue, Athena, SageMaker Unified Studio), building consensus on shared architecture and delivering outcomes that span team charters.
Champion performance and price-performance leadership across serverless, automated cluster management, and real-world customer workloads.
Partner with AI/ML and science teams to advance natural language-to-SQL capabilities and integrate generative AI into the analytics experience.
Build and maintain relationships with strategic customers, incorporating feedback into the engine roadmap.
Establish engineering best practices, mentoring programs, and career development frameworks for a high-performing global team.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Statistics or 12+ years equivalent experience
10+ years of software engineering experience
10+ years leading distributed engineering teams
Experience with large-scale data systems or database technologies

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years of software engineering experience with 5+ years in a senior leadership role (Director or equivalent)
Deep expertise in database internals, query processing, query optimization, or distributed execution engines
Track record delivering complex, large-scale infrastructure or platform products at thousands-of-customers scale
Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams across multiple time zones
Demonstrated ability to drive cross-organizational alignment and influence technical direction across partner organizations
Strong understanding of cloud architectures, data analytics patterns, and data lake/open-format ecosystems (Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or similar)
Experience with query optimizer design, cost-based optimization, high-performance execution engines, or petabyte-scale workload management
Background in AI/ML-powered systems, including large language models, agentic architectures, or natural language interfaces for data systems
Track record building and shipping serverless or auto-scaling distributed data systems
Experience collaborating across diverse analytics or data platform organizations (e.g., data catalog, ETL, query federation, ML platforms)
Executive presence with excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to influence VP and C-level
Published research or patents in databases, query processing, or related fields

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Director of Engineering to guide the development of AI-native, production-ready machine learning products for external clients. This leader will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of sophisticated AI systems—from product conception and rollout to production, customer engagement, and continuous operational success.

This role requires a rare blend of hands‑on technical depth, product judgment, and senior‑level people leadership. You will lead a highly experienced ML engineering organization and work closely with Product, Development, and Go‑to‑Market partners to bring differentiated AI solutions to market.

Key Responsibilities

Technical & Product Leadership

Own the end‑to‑end delivery of AI/ML solutions deployed in production, moving beyond proofs‑of‑concept to scalable, reliable, customer‑facing systems.
Lead deep technical discussions on system build, model integration, performance, reliability, and operational readiness.
Collaborate directly with Product Management to build product vision, challenge assumptions, and ensure differentiation beyond general‑purpose LLM capabilities.
Drive architectural decisions that balance innovation, scalability, cost, and long‑term maintainability.
Act as a senior technical voice with customers, handling partner concerns, roadmap discussions, and production issue resolution.

Team & Organizational Leadership

Establish, grow, and manage a high-caliber ML engineering organization, scaling the team from about 4 to over 20 engineers as time progresses.
Manage and mentor senior engineers and leaders with 16+ years of experience, encouraging accountability, ownership, and continuous growth.
Establish a flat, hands‑on, hybrid operating model where leaders stay close to the work while empowering teams to implement initiatives independently.
Conduct performance management, career development, and succession planning aligned to director‑level expectations.

Execution & Operations

Ensure excellence in production operations, including monitoring, incident response, model performance, and customer‑reported issues.
Drive strong engineering rigor across testing, release readiness, and post‑launch support.
Build scalable processes that support rapid iteration while maintaining enterprise‑grade reliability.

Required Qualifications

Over 15 years of experience in software engineering, with extensive expertise in machine learning or systems driven by artificial intelligence.
Demonstrated history of delivering and managing AI/ML products in production, beyond just experimentation or research.
Strong business and commercial exposure, with direct ownership or leadership of a customer-facing, revenue-impacting AI/ML product.
Strong experience with ML system build, production architecture, and real‑world operational challenges.
Demonstrated success leading senior technical teams, including performance evaluations, mentoring, and org scaling.
Ability to engage deeply with product partners and debate technical and product tradeoffs in fast paced environments.
Experience working directly with external customers and understanding customer‑facing production realities.

Preferred Background

Proven track record of building AI/ML products in startup or startup-like contexts that prioritize rapid market introduction.
Background in external, customer‑facing platforms or products, particularly AI‑first offerings.
Familiarity with domains such as marketing technology, sales technology, or customer experience platforms.

Leadership Attributes We Value

Hands‑on, credible technical leadership with the ability to go deep when needed.
Strong product intuition paired with engineering rigor.
Comfort operating in ambiguity while building structure for scale.
Ability to earn trust quickly with senior engineers, product leaders, and customers.

jobs.title: Director, Core Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Networking is the foundation that enables customers to run mission-critical workloads at global cloud scale.

We're rearchitecting OCI's physical network control and management systems from the ground up to support the next generation of networking services. This is a unique opportunity to influence the architecture of one of the world's largest cloud networking platforms. We're looking for experienced leaders with proven record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems, deep understanding of distributed orchestration services, and a passion for growing high-performant teams to join our leadership team.

Our team develops the core infrastructure that powers OCI Networking's control plane, solving complex challenges in managing network configuration at cloud scale. You'll collaborate across OCI Networking and Infrastructure teams to shape the future of OCI Networking.

Responsibilities

As a Director of Software Engineering, you will lead teams that design, develop, deploy, and operate highly available, large-scale distributed services for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Networking. You will apply your engineering leadership experience and knowledge of software architecture to deliver critical infrastructure that powers OCI Networking’s control and management systems.

Responsibilities

Lead and develop software engineering teams through engineering managers and technical leads.
Drive execution of technical and organizational priorities, ensuring delivery of reliable, scalable, and operable services.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering – Agentic Product
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe is reimagining the future of creativity — where generative AI, intelligent agents, and human imagination work hand in hand. As the Director of Engineering, Agentic Product, you will lead the technical execution of Adobe's Agentic Product: the AI-native experience that brings generative models, creative intelligence, and decades of differentiated Adobe capabilities together into a coherent, high-quality product for creators used by hundreds of millions of people every day. You'll partner directly with Product leadership to define, build, and ship agentic experiences that meaningfully change how creators work.

You'll be responsible for the end-to-end product quality of the agent: its capabilities, its behaviors, and the experience it delivers across surfaces. This is a focused, product-minded engineering leadership role — you are accountable for what the agent does and how well it works, not for the underlying platform or ecosystem packaging.

This is a rare opportunity to build a new, AI-native engineering team and practices that will define Adobe's most visible AI product. The right person brings experience leading engineering teams that ship high-quality, user-facing AI experiences, a strong point of view on what "great" looks like for creative AI, and the ability to raise the bar in a space that is moving fast.

Senior Director-level may be considered for those with the right experience and technical depth.

What You'll Do

Lead the engineering execution of Adobe's Agentic Product — collaborating to define what the agent does, driving the quality of its outputs, and ensuring it ships on a predictable cadence across surfaces.
Grow and lead the engineering team building Agentic Product capabilities, driving technical strategy, team health, and execution velocity.
Partner closely with the Agentic Product Management leads to define technical scope, sequence delivery, and translate product strategy into executable engineering plans.
Lead the design and delivery of agent capabilities spanning in-app creative workflows, multi-step task execution, and context-aware assistance across Adobe's surfaces.
Establish and maintain the quality bar for agent behavior — what good looks like, how it's measured, and how the team systematically improves it over time.
Partner across Adobe's platform and infrastructure teams to ensure the Agentic Product is built with appropriate evals, guardrails, data protection, and the reliability expected of a product at Adobe's scale.
Build and maintain fluency across the emerging agentic standards and model capabilities ecosystem and ensure Adobe's Agentic Product engineering practices evolve with the space.

What You'll Need To Succeed

A track record of leading and scaling high-performing engineering teams to ship complex, high-quality user-facing AI products at scale.
Deep experience with AI/ML product engineering, including working knowledge of LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and the capabilities and limitations of current generative models in creative contexts.
Hands-on technical expertise: you can engage deeply in architecture decisions, review designs with a substantive point of view, and recognize good and brittle agent behavior at the implementation level — not just the product level. You remain close to the code and the craft.
Strong product sensibility — you have intuitions about user experience, you can look at agent behavior and know when it's good or brittle, and you partner with PM and design as a peer, not a downstream executor.
Strong cross-functional leadership instincts with a history of effective partnership with Product, Design, and platform engineering teams.
Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the technology, the competitive dynamics, and the user expectations are all rapidly evolving.
Experience with the quality, reliability, and trust requirements that come with shipping AI features to a large consumer and enterprise audience.
Demonstrated ability to lead change management and drive continuous innovation in engineering processes and practices — helping teams adopt new ways of working, internalize new tooling, and stay ahead of a rapidly shifting technical landscape without losing execution focus.
Experience working with LLM providers or contributing to AI product strategy is strongly preferred.

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the role
  Software engineering is at an inflection point — and Enterprise Engineering at Roku sits right at the center of it. Applications are increasingly built to plug into AI platforms — exposing their capabilities as services for agents rather than standing alone as siloed apps — and the once-clear lines between engineering disciplines are blurring, rewarding versatile engineers who can work across the stack and own outcomes end to end. At the same time, AI is raising the bar on what a lean engineering organization can deliver.  
Roku is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead the organization that builds the custom applications, integrations, enterprise data, AI and agentic capabilities, and productivity platforms that power how the company runs. This is a senior leadership role: you’ll set the technical vision, shape our architecture for an AI-native future, and make Enterprise Engineering’s systems agent-ready — all while championing engineering excellence in quality, security, and speed.  
Reporting to the VP of Enterprise Engineering, you will lead a global organization across teams in the US, UK, and India. You’ll own the software engineering organization building Roku’s custom enterprise applications, integrations, and enterprise data; Productivity Engineering, the platforms and workflows that shape how thousands of employees work each day; and enterprise AI enablement — the AI-enabled capabilities that let our systems and our people operate with far greater leverage.  
The ideal candidate is a builder-architect and a transformation leader. You have deep, current expertise in AI and software architecture and a clear point of view on where software is heading, and you have repeatedly reshaped teams and lifted engineering standards to meet that direction. You care as much about how work gets done — the architecture, the rigor, the ways of working — as about what gets shipped.  
For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $650,000 - $750,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. 

What you’ll be doing
  Technical Direction & Architecture

Set the technical vision and standards for the software engineering organization that builds Roku’s custom enterprise applications, integrations, and enterprise data.  

Advance our architecture and engineering practices — driving cloud-native design, strong engineering and security discipline, and fast, reliable delivery.  

AI & the Agentic Platform

Drive our  enterprise AI enablement  strategy — building the reusable foundations for agent-ready systems (identity-aware MCP services, reusable skills, eval practices, and a governed  context layer) and enabling teams across the organization to build, adopt, and operate AI capabilities themselves.  

Lead the organization’s shift to AI-first engineering: drive team-wide AI adoption, create the psychological safety for teams to experiment and learn, redesign workflows around AI rather than bolting it on, and establish standards for the quality and accountability of AI-assisted work.  

Organization & Transformation

Reshape team topology around outcomes as the boundaries between engineering disciplines blur, evolving the org toward versatile, product-aligned teams.  

Build, coach, and uplift a high-performing, geographically distributed engineering team, and serve as a thought partner to executive leadership.  

Enterprise Scope & Governance

Own Productivity Engineering: the platforms, workflows, and tools that shape how thousands of employees collaborate, execute, and make decisions.  

Partner on the architecture and execution of major enterprise tentpole initiatives that span multiple systems and teams.  

Operate with the governance, security, audit, and compliance discipline (including SOX) that enterprise systems require.  

We’re excited if you have
  1 5 + years building and leading software engineering teams, including significant experience leading managers and/or senior engineers in an organization of scale.  

Deep, current expertise in cloud architecture and software engineering, with the judgment to set architectural direction and go as deep as a problem requires — whether as a hands-on architect or leading through strong managers.  

Personal, current fluency with the agentic engineering toolchain — conversational AI and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) used across the full software development lifecycle — with the judgment to drive an agent, verify its output, and lead by example. Depth in LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, MCP integration, and eval-driven development.  

A track record of raising engineering standards in an existing organization — modernizing architecture, embedding secure-by-design practices, and improving quality, rigor, and agility.  

Conviction and experience in organizational design, including reshaping teams around outcomes and evolving operating models.  

Experience with enterprise or internal platforms and the governance, security, and compliance that come with them; large-scale enterprise system modernization is a strong plus.  

Change leadership: a demonstrated ability to move an organization to new, AI-enabled ways of working and to protect strategic capacity against the gravity of run-the-business work.  

Exceptional executive presence, a data-driven mindset, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.  

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.  
We value your AI skills if you’ve built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks — and you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.  
What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 
To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

Description

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines is a suite of fully managed, high-performance analytics services built on popular open-source frameworks, enabling customers to process, analyze, and derive insights from massive datasets with speed, flexibility, and cost efficiency. Open Data Analytics Engines make it easy for organizations to run petabyte-scale analytics using familiar open-source tools without the operational burden of managing infrastructure.

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines encompasses services purpose-built for large-scale data processing, interactive querying, real-time streaming, and machine learning workloads. The platform leverages open-source engines such as Apache Spark, Presto/Trino, Apache Flink, and Apache Hive, delivering seamless integration with the broader AWS ecosystem. Compute and storage are decoupled, enabling elastic scaling, fine-grained cost optimization, and support for diverse data lake architectures.

As Director of Engineering for Open Data Analytics Engines, you will lead a group of top talent in advancing the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, features, and performance. You'll drive the design, development, and operation of next-generation open-source analytics services on AWS, shaping the future of how customers run large-scale queries in the cloud.

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) provides industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance for object storage. Through the use of pioneering techniques in large-scale distributed computing, developers can durably store their data on AWS’s proven computing infrastructure to achieve virtually limitless storage capacity at minimal cost. Amazon S3 provides simple APIs that can be used to store and retrieve any amount of data at any time. Customers of all sizes, from day one startups to the world’s largest enterprises, use Amazon S3 to deliver next-generation applications that range from data analytics to AI to photo and video archives. While S3 has seen tremendous growth since launch in 2006, we are still in the early stages of realizing its full potential.

As a Director of Software Development for the S3 Storage Engine organization, you will be responsible for leading a group of top talent in the design and development of S3’s core storage distributed system. We build innovative software solutions to provide S3 customers secure, durable, available and performant storage with infinite scalability and extremely low cost. In this role you will drive the roadmap, deliver new functionality and architectures, and raise the bar for operational excellence. You’ll lead multiple engineering teams through managers across different geographic locations. You'll spearhead new technologies that change what is possible within S3. You'll be a leader in the business as well, owning the financial health of your services. You’ll personally engage with C-suite customers to represent the Amazon S3 business.

Success in this role requires a leader experienced in establishing and building relationships with a wide range of peers, including senior AWS executives, customers at all levels of experience and responsibility, deeply technical software and systems engineers within the team, and internal organizations. This leader must have the proven skills to easily switch between weighing in on complex engineering details, taking a long-term view of the business, growing and developing the next generation of AWS leadership, and overall operating as a large-scale organization leader. It requires an ability to prioritize work for the direct team and partner teams, establish goals, and focus attention on the most important inputs to drive the desired business outcomes. This leader must be capable of scaling themselves and their team to meet the ever-increasing demands of a fast-growing business. You’ll need to excel at hiring and developing your technical talent. S3 operates at massive scale and stores critical data for customers world-wide, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key. Come work hard and make history with Amazon S3!

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (related field) or equivalent work experience
10+ years' experience architecting fault tolerant and high available systems
5+ years' experience managing people with 3+ years of managing multiple managers/teams.
5+ years' experience owning 24x7x365 service operations

A leadership position in a team delivering solutions at scale.
Master’s or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering with a minimum of 10 years of relevant software development and engineering management experience.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. Data Center capacity planning and reporting
May assist in the design and build out of new facilities
Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Responsible for asset and inventory management

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Director of Data to own our data strategy and platform as we scale toward software-defined vehicles.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll set technical direction and stay close to the architecture and code, while building and managing a high-performing team responsible for high-volume, high-velocity vehicle and enterprise data.

You'll bring both the technical depth to make sound platform decisions and the people leadership to grow and run a team operating at scale.

We're hiring for this role in Palo Alto, Irvine, or Vancouver. We are happy to work with whichever location suits you best.

Responsibilities

Define and drive the data strategy and roadmap across vehicle telemetry, manufacturing, and enterprise data domains, aligning with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
Own architecture decisions for large-scale data platforms (ingestion, storage, processing, and serving layers) handling high-volume streaming and batch data.
Stay hands-on: review designs and code, dive into pipeline or performance issues, and set technical standards by example, not just by policy.
Recruit, manage, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers and analytics professionals; own hiring plans, performance management, and career development.
Partner with quality, manufacturing, product, and software engineering teams to ensure data infrastructure supports reliability, safety, and product analytics needs.
Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across pipelines and platforms, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory and privacy requirements.
Build and maintain stakeholder-facing reporting on platform health, data quality, and delivery against roadmap commitments.
Evaluate and integrate modern tooling (e.g., Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud data warehouses, AI/LLM-assisted engineering tools) to keep the platform and team ahead of scale demands.
Manage budget, vendor, and tooling decisions for the data organization.

Demonstrated hands-on technical depth in building and operating large-scale data systems, proficiency in SQL and Python required, along with hands-on experience with Databricks required (additional experience with Spark or equivalent distributed data platforms a plus).

Strong cross-functional partnership skills and being comfortable working with engineering, product, quality, and manufacturing stakeholders to translate business needs into data infrastructure.
Experience establishing data governance, quality, and security practices at an organizational level.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree a plus.

Experience integrating or prompting AI/LLM tools into engineering workflows.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

Role Overview

The Senior Manager, AI Power & Performance (AI PnP) will lead a team responsible for delivering industry-leading AI performance, power efficiency, benchmarking, characterization, and optimization across AMD's Embedded and Edge AI platforms. This leader will partner closely with architecture, software, silicon, product management, marketing, and customer-facing teams to ensure AMD solutions achieve competitive leadership in AI workloads spanning Robotics, Physical AI, Automotive, Industrial, and Edge Computing.

Why Join Physical AI Organization?

Join a fast-growing organization shaping AMD's vision for Physical AI, Robotics, Automotive, Industrial, and Edge AI solutions. This role offers the opportunity to influence next-generation AI platforms, build world-class engineering teams, and drive technology that powers intelligent systems across a wide range of industries.

Success Metrics

Performance-per-watt leadership against competitive solutions.
AI workload enablement and optimization coverage across strategic platforms.
Customer adoption and design-win support effectiveness.
Engineering productivity improvements through automation and tooling.
Delivery of trusted, reproducible, customer-ready performance data.
Successful execution of roadmap commitments and organizational growth.

Technical Leadership

Define and execute AI power and performance strategy across AMD CPU, GPU, NPU, and heterogeneous computing platforms.
Establish benchmarking methodologies, performance KPIs, competitive analysis frameworks, and workload characterization processes.
Drive performance optimization across AI models, runtimes, kernels, frameworks, and system software stacks.

Product and Solution Enablement

Lead performance readiness for AI solutions across Robotics, Physical AI, Automotive, Industrial, and Edge AI markets.
Develop customer-ready performance collateral, benchmarking reports, tuning recommendations, and competitive positioning data.
Partner with software engineering teams to validate AI models, inference pipelines, SDKs, frameworks, and application workloads.

Customer and Cross-Functional Engagement

Collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, Software Engineering, Marketing, and Field Engineering teams to define and execute winning AI platform strategies.
Represent AMD performance leadership in executive reviews, customer meetings, and industry engagements.

Automation and Infrastructure

Drive development of scalable benchmarking, automation, telemetry, profiling, and analytics infrastructure.
Establish continuous performance validation frameworks and dashboards for workload tracking and regression analysis.
Improve engineering efficiency through CI/CD integration and automated performance qualification systems.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Communications
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, Communications, you'll lead the team responsible for in-game text chat — one of the most-used surfaces on Roblox and a cornerstone of how our community connects. Every day this system carries billions of messages across hundreds of millions of users, in real time, across 2D and 3D spaces, on every device we support. You'll own the roadmap and the engineering org behind it: building rich, immersive, and engaging communication experiences that let people and creators express themselves safely and seamlessly — better than in real life.

This is a role for a leader who thinks like a product builder as much as an engineer. You'll balance the demands of massive scale and rock-solid reliability with a relentless focus on the user experience, shipping features that make conversation on Roblox feel effortless, expressive, and safe. You'll grow and develop a team of engineers, set technical direction, and partner deeply across product, design, trust & safety, and infrastructure to define what communication on Roblox becomes next.

You Will

Lead, grow, and develop a team of software engineers building the in-game text chat platform, setting a high bar for engineering excellence, ownership, and career growth.
Own the technical vision and multi-quarter roadmap for real-time text messaging, balancing new product capabilities against scale, latency, reliability, and cost.
Drive the architecture and evolution of messaging systems that reliably deliver billions of messages per day at low latency to a global, cross-platform audience.
Partner with product and design to shape a compelling communication experience — treating chat as a product, not just infrastructure — and translate ambiguous goals into concrete plans and shipped features.
Collaborate closely with Trust & Safety, Policy, and ML teams to ensure every messaging experience is safe and civil by design for a young, global user base.
Establish strong engineering practices around quality, observability, on-call health, and operational excellence for systems that must always be available.
Communicate clearly and influence across the organization — with peers, leadership, and cross-functional partners — to align teams behind a shared direction.

You Have

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing and growing engineering teams.
A track record of building and shipping consumer-facing products at scale — ideally messaging, communications, social, or other real-time systems.
Strong product intuition: you make thoughtful tradeoffs between user experience, technical complexity, and speed, and you care about what you ship, not just how it's built.
Deep experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a strong grasp of reliability, latency, and the realities of running high-throughput services in production.
Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain strong engineers, and to build healthy, high-performing teams.
Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with a history of driving alignment across product, design, and engineering.
A bias toward action and a comfort with ambiguity, especially at high scale.

You Might Also Have

Experience with real-time messaging protocols, presence systems, or high-fanout delivery infrastructure.
Background in trust & safety, content moderation, or safety-critical systems.
Experience building communication or social features for large, global, or youth audiences.
Familiarity with cross-platform (mobile, console, desktop) product development.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Controls Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a leader for the Controls Engineering function. As the single-threaded owner of controls and automation strategy, your organization will own the full lifecycle—design, programming, commissioning, deployment, ramp, and sustained operations. You will define controls standards, architect the integration strategy across MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA layers, and partner with integrators to ensure flawless execution.

This role spans pilot operations through high-volume production across diverse processes. You will build a multi-disciplinary team of controls, automation, and SCADA engineers who support line development, launch, and sustained production. You will operate with high autonomy and a bias for action—diving deep into systems architecture and team development while ensuring daily production reliability, safety, and performance.

Key job responsibilities

Controls Design & Development

Define and implement global PLC architecture, programming standards, and controls design specifications. Establish a scalable framework supporting pilot through high-volume production.
Develop and enforce controls standards (hardware, software, networking); ensure system integrators and vendors deliver in strict compliance.
Own the SCADA/HMI layer strategy (e.g., Ignition)—design, deploy, and maintain systems providing real-time visibility into line performance, alarms, and production data.
Lead automation integration (e.g., Fanuc, Kuka) across assembly and automation cells, ensuring standardized programming, safety compliance, and maintainability.
Own functional safety design (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and enforce equipment safety standards for all automated systems, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and Amazon safety requirements.

MES & Systems Integration

Architect the MES integration strategy bridging MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA layers. Ensure seamless data flow from shop floor to enterprise systems.
Partner with the Factory Software team on system architecture, data models, and integration. Define clear interface boundaries and ensure coordinated deployment.
Drive traceability, genealogy, and quality data capture at the controls layer to support analytics, yield improvement, and regulatory compliance.
Establish standards for connectivity protocols (OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET), data historians, and reporting infrastructure enabling data-driven decision making.

Line Deployment, Commissioning & Ramp

Own controls engineering scope for line deployment: design review, vendor management, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and ramp to high-volume production.
Manage system integrator relationships end-to-end: define specifications, conduct design reviews, enforce adherence to controls standards, and drive issue resolution.
Lead troubleshooting, optimization, cycle time improvement, and reliability growth through production ramp to steady-state operations.
Collaborate with Operations, Process Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure controls solutions meet their operational and production requirements.
Drive root cause analysis on system failures; implement countermeasures and preventive mechanisms to improve reliability and uptime.
Develop commissioning playbooks, validation protocols, and startup checklists enabling repeatable, rapid line launches across facilities.

Team Building & Sustained Operations

Build the Controls Engineering organization from the ground up: hire and develop a multi-disciplinary team of controls, automation, SCADA, and MES engineers plus technicians.
Establish team structure and operating model supporting line development, launch, and sustained operations with 24/7 production support capability.
Create mechanisms for knowledge management, troubleshooting databases, and continuous improvement of controls reliability (MTTR/MTBF).
Own technical documentation for all electrical and control systems.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and operational rigor with the highest standards for system quality and documentation.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 1+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
10+ years of experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, or related disciplines.
5+ years in a leadership role building and managing multi-disciplinary controls/automation engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience deploying control systems from pilot through volume production, including FAT, SAT, commissioning, and ramp.
Hands-on experience in production environments with exposure to operations and the practical challenges of sustaining automated systems.
Expertise in PLC programming and architecture (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000/ControlLogix).
Experience with SCADA/HMI system design, deployment, and management (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, WinCC).
Experience managing system integrators and ensuring vendor compliance with controls standards. Working knowledge of MES architecture and integration with ERP, WMS, QMS, and shop-floor systems.
Experience in high-mix or evolving product environments where controls systems must adapt to frequent design changes.

Preferred Qualifications

15+ years in controls or automation with progressive leadership responsibilities, including greenfield production launches.
Experience in automotive, aerospace, battery/energy, or other advanced production environments at scale.
Expertise in industrial automation programming and integration (Fanuc, KUKA, ABB, or similar acceptable).
Experience building controls standards and architecture from scratch for a new organization.
Knowledge of industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, OPC-UA), OT cybersecurity, IT/OT convergence, data historians, and production analytics.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and simplify complex control system architectures at scale.
Familiarity with safety system design (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and compliance with relevant standards (IEC 62443, NFPA 79, ISO 13849).
Master's degree in Engineering or MBA with technical background. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for executive-level technical narratives.
Track record of delivering results in fast-paced, high-growth environments with strong ownership and bias for action.

This is a critical senior leadership role spanning the full breadth of AWS's real-time data movement portfolio—from open-source streaming technologies to AWS-native messaging and delivery solutions.

Think strategically and execute relentlessly — Innovate on behalf of customers while remaining deeply connected to engineering execution. Apply relentlessly high standards to lead the development of purpose-built, large-scale systems.
Lead at scale — Direct geographically distributed teams (Seattle, Vancouver BC, Palo Alto CA, Cambridge UK, and beyond) to build and operate next-generation high-performance streaming and messaging systems that deliver real-time ingestion, storage, processing, and delivery for large-scale applications.

Experience designing and building sophisticated, fault-tolerant, distributed systems with systems-level performance constraints

Experience driving complex, cross-organizational projects across VP-level stakeholders

The OCI Compute Control Plane team is at the center of many of OCI’s most critical business goals. We are challenged with scaling our services to meet growing demand, delivering critical features for our customers to help them manage their Compute instances, and delivering support for new HW platforms. We support both Bare Metal and Virtual machine instances across a diverse fleet of HW, including clustered GPU platforms. In addition, our customers demand high availability and security from our Cloud. We need a leader who can thrive in ambiguity, make data-driven decisions, and think critically about how to solve complex problems. We seek someone who can inspire others, and explain the “why” behind every project and every priority call.

This role will have focus areas in both our Compute Metering and Compute Dynamic Power Management spaces. The role will involve setting the strategic vision and near-term roadmap items, executing on delivery in an efficient manner, cultivating a culture of high standards for quality and delivery, and growing the team. The successful hire will have a passion for automation, solving complex problems, and working in a high-impact, fast-paced environment.

This is a highly visible and impactful role based in Nashville, TN. You will be co-located with key leadership to maximize collaboration, accelerate delivery, and support OCI’s strategic growth initiatives.

Note that this role is onsite in our downtown Nashville offices and Oracle is 5 days in the office.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

Organizational Leadership : Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing engineering organization, ensuring the professional growth of engineers.
Architecture & Delivery : Oversee software architecture, development, debugging, and enhancement activities in line with design specifications and business requirements. Advocate for and drive improvements within existing architectures, guiding your team in delivering resilient, automated, and scalable solutions. Set clear, measurable goals; monitor progress and hold teams accountable for achieving key deliverables at high quality.
Strategy & Roadmap : Define and execute the technology roadmap and operational strategies for compute developer efficiency and AI intiatives , ensuring alignment with OCI’s priorities.
Operational Excellence: Build and maintain operational support structure for your services, including on-call rotations. Lead operational incidents to resolution as necessary. Deliver post-mortem analysis for operational incidents and drive necessary improvements in process and services to improve availability as a result.
Communication : Articulate forward-looking plans, strategies, and project outcomes to leadership and stakeholders, ensuring widespread understanding, support, and alignment.
Hiring and Talent Development : Responsible for hiring plans and attainment of hiring goals. Lead by example in identifying and nurturing talent, conducting career development conversations, and promoting a culture of continuous learning and advancement.

Qualifications

Leadership Experience : 10 years engineering experience, including at least 2 years as a people manager.
Technical Proficiency : Strong, hands-on technical background, with knowledge of software development, cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, and cloud compute systems.
Vision : Proven ability to define and execute strategic and operational roadmaps for technical organizations.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Enterprise Foundations
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Enterprise Foundations is the engineering team responsible for the architectural and integration work that allows Instacart's Retailer Platform to scale across the world's largest grocers. Our work spans omnichannel integrations — bringing products like FoodStorm catering and Caper Carts onto unified Instacart platform rails — enterprise extensibility (sandbox environments, configuration systems, retailer-facing tooling), and the cross-cutting data isolation work that allows Instacart's ML and Data Engineering teams to safely build per-retailer models on top of the platform. As Instacart's enterprise retail business expands to hundreds of partner brands and new international markets, this team's work is foundational to how the platform matures.

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead this team of ~12 engineers. You'll set the unifying technical thesis for the team — multi-tenancy, data isolation, configuration-driven release management, and per-retailer extensibility — and drive the consolidation work that replaces bespoke per-vertical services with shared platform rails. In close partnership with Connected Stores, Pro Services, Commerce, Data Engineering, and ML, you'll broker the architectural and prioritization trade-offs that determine how Instacart serves enterprise retailers across multiple commerce surfaces.

About The Job

Lead, coach, and grow a senior-skewed team of ~12 engineers across multiple workstreams; set clear architectural and execution direction, develop talent, and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Set and maintain the unifying technical thesis for the team — multi-tenancy, data isolation, configuration-driven release management, and per-retailer extensibility — ensuring related workstreams converge on shared solutions rather than parallel implementations.
Drive consolidation of bespoke retailer-vertical services — catering order management, smart-cart backend logic, kiosk integrations, in-store mobile — onto unified Instacart platform rails, so each surface inherits Instacart's ranking, search, recommendations, and fulfillment.
Partner with ML and Data Engineering on long-term enterprise data platform compliance for our ML systems, ensuring per-retailer model training has the data, signals, and isolation it needs.
Deliver self-service tooling — including sandbox environments, configuration interfaces, and retailer-facing extensibility — that lets retailers and internal teams ship without engineering bottlenecks.
Represent technical and product trade-offs across multiple engineering and product organizations whose roadmaps and integration commitments evolve in real time; broker resourcing decisions, drive clarity in ambiguous scope, and ensure engineering investment stays aligned with committed work.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineering teams delivering platform or infrastructure products in a B2B or enterprise context.
Experience leading teams of 10+ engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development of senior individual contributors.
Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments where partner roadmaps, product coverage, and integration commitments are still maturing — with a track record of driving clarity and forward motion through that ambiguity.
Proven cross-functional leadership influencing outcomes across multiple engineering and product organizations, including comfort using structured escalation to unblock multi-team initiatives.
Experience leading multi-team architectural transitions such as consolidation, replatforming, multi-tenancy, or data isolation inside an established business with real customers and revenue.
Technical proficiency in distributed systems, API/SDK design, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS or GCP).
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct domain experience in commerce platforms, omnichannel retail, OMS, POS, catering systems, or connected-store / in-store technology.
Track record of building multi-tenant platforms serving multiple internal or external customers, with per-tenant configuration, isolation, and extensibility requirements.
Experience partnering with ML and Data Engineering teams on data platform compliance, model training infrastructure, or data isolation initiatives.
Background scaling enterprise integrations and managing partner-facing technical relationships across product, engineering, and customer-facing functions.
Experience leading other engineering managers and growing two-layer organizations.

Description

Amazon Enterprise Security Products is a newly launched group building intelligent, cloud-agnostic security tools using AI-first development practices. We don't just talk about AI — we build AI security products with AI, and we need a leader who sets that standard. This is a ground-floor opportunity to build and lead a high-performing engineering organization where experimentation is the norm, shipping is measured in hours not quarters, and every decision you make shapes the trajectory of the team, the product, and the business. If you've been waiting for a role where you can combine the strategic scope of senior leadership with the hands-on intensity of a startup founder — this is it.

Build and lead a world-class engineering organization. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent. Stand up multiple development teams from the ground up, establishing the structures, rituals, and expectations that define how a high-performing org operates — without the bureaucracy.
Set technical vision and product strategy: Partner with security researchers, applied scientists, product managers, and UX designers to translate customer problems into bold technical bets. Your decisions will shape architecture, product direction, and competitive positioning.

Don't just encourage adoption; measure it, iterate on it, and make it a force multiplier for velocity and quality. You set the bar for how this org builds.
Drive execution with startup urgency: Manage multiple concurrent initiatives across teams while maintaining the speed and focus of a small, scrappy operation. Decompose ambiguous, high-stakes problems into actionable plans. Remove blockers ruthlessly. Ship fast, learn from what you ship, and iterate.
Define and advance AI/ML capabilities: Lead strategic decisions on agentic systems, RAG architectures, conversational interfaces, and intelligent automation pipelines. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and make high-judgment build vs. buy decisions that keep the team on the forefront of AI.

Influence beyond your org: Drive cross-organizational initiatives, build consensus with senior stakeholders, and write compelling vision documents and strategic narratives. Proactively identify technology gaps and opportunities that extend beyond your immediate scope.

You start the morning reviewing a product vision draft for a new AI-powered security capability. jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) provides industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance for object storage. Through the use of pioneering techniques in large-scale distributed computing, developers can durably store their data on AWS's proven computing infrastructure to achieve virtually limitless storage capacity at minimal cost. Amazon S3 provides simple APIs that can be used to store and retrieve any amount of data at any time. Customers of all sizes, from day one startups to the world's largest enterprises, use Amazon S3 to deliver next-generation applications that range from data analytics to AI to photo and video archives. While S3 has seen tremendous growth since launch in 2006, we are still in the early stages of realizing its full potential.

As a Sr. Manager, Software Development for S3 Request Processing, you will be responsible for leading a group of top talent that builds the software handling every S3 request at massive scale. Your organization owns the request processing platform, the business logic that implements S3's API surface, and the security controls that keep customer data safe. We build innovative software solutions to provide S3 customers secure, durable, available, and performant request handling with virtually infinite scale and extremely low cost. In this role you will drive the roadmap, deliver new functionality and architectures, and raise the bar for operational excellence. You'll lead multiple engineering teams to spearhead new technologies that change what is possible within S3. You'll also own the financial health of your services and engage directly with senior customers to represent the S3 business.

Success in this role requires a leader experienced in establishing and building relationships with a wide range of peers, including senior AWS leaders, customers at all levels of experience and responsibility, deeply technical software and systems engineers within the team, and partner organizations across S3 and AWS. This leader must have the proven skills to easily switch between weighing in on complex engineering details of a high-throughput, low-latency request path, taking a long-term view of the business, growing and developing the next generation of AWS engineering and management talent, and operating as a large-organization leader. This leader must be capable of scaling themselves and their team to meet the ever-increasing demands of a fast-growing business. You'll need to excel at hiring and developing your technical talent. jobs.description:
Description

Amazon S3 Tables is the first cloud object store with built-in Apache Iceberg support, purpose-built for storing and querying tabular data at massive scale. It is fully managed, continuously optimizing, and delivers up-to 10x higher transactions per second than Iceberg tables on general purpose S3 buckets, all within the same foundation that gives S3 eleven nines of durability. Customers are bringing their most demanding analytics workloads to S3 Tables, from streaming ingestion of IoT and application telemetry to multi-petabyte lakehouses powering multiple AWS and partner query engines, and a growing wave of AI agents that query data directly through the Model Context Protocol. Our mission is simple and ambitious which is to make S3 Tables the best place on Earth to store and query Iceberg data, and reinvent what an analytics-native object store can be.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the multi-team S3 Tables organization. In this role, you will own the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution for the service, working at a scale that very few engineers in the industry ever encounter. Your organization will ship innovations that customers feel directly in query latency, cost per terabyte scanned, ingestion throughput, and the simplicity of running an open lakehouse on AWS.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, open-source table formats, and large-scale analytics. You will help define how Iceberg evolves in the cloud, partnering with the Apache Iceberg community and with engine teams across AWS and partners to make sure S3 Tables is the gravitational center of the open analytics ecosystem. Internally, you will partner with S3 storage, indexing, and control plane teams, and with AWS analytics leadership, to deliver a service that is both deeply integrated and uncompromisingly open.

We want a leader who thinks big, invents on behalf of customers, and is energized by problems that only show up at S3 scale. The bar is high and the opportunity to shape how the world stores and analyzes its data is higher.

S3 Tables is a new, fast moving team building within the most durable and scalable storage system ever built. We are early in our journey, the product is young, the customer base is growing quickly, and the surface area in front of us is large. We are doing this in the open with Apache Iceberg, obsessing over customer workloads, and inventing in places others assume are solved. If you want to help build something into what it can become, rather than maintain what already is, this is the team.
