Lead and grow a multi-team organization of senior engineers and engineering managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, deep ownership, and customer obsession.

Drive architectural decisions for distributed systems at exabyte scale, including metadata services, compaction and optimization pipelines, snapshot and transaction management, and engine integrations.
Make S3 Tables the highest performing, most cost effective home for Apache Iceberg anywhere, and contribute back to the Iceberg open source project.
Partner with product, business, and AWS analytics leadership to translate customer needs into engineering priorities that move adoption and trust.
Establish operational excellence standards across availability, durability, latency, and throughput, and lead the org in exceeding them as the service scales.

jobs.description:
Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
, we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start-up, with the scale and customer-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world.

Values are OCI’s foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions.

We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future.

You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you’ll belong and be encouraged.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a manager with distributed systems experience - building cost efficient and scalable systems from scratch. You have led a team covering at least a single service or multiple micro-services within a larger service. You were fully responsible for design, delivery, and operations of all components in this space. You are an expert manager and owned roadmap planning, talent review, and goal setting for your team. You have been responsible for building your team including recruiting, hiring, and performance management.

You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations. You stay up at night thinking about how to protect the service from upstream dependencies. You will be technically strong and get a lot done – you’ve worked on services that are highly available, scalable, and redundant. You understand that simple systems are easier to operate and troubleshoot. You can balance speed and quality with iteration and incremental improvements. You’ve made life easier for your developers and have motivated your teams to make both process and service improvements with your ability to automate and instrument properly to get the right data. You understand operational perfection and how to instill a culture of being proactive with your teammates. The person in this role will get a lot done on a daily basis, grow and develop the team and roadmap, drive execution of features and projects, and own feature design.

What are the biggest challenges for the team?

The biggest product challenges for the team are scalability, performance, availability, operations. The growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today. We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right trade-offs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution. We need managers who can lead their team to build services that handle millions of requests per second. We seek managers who can determine how we can survive regional data center outages and protect our customers. We need managers who can enable their team to build services that enable us to offer even more options to customers and contribute to the overall growth of Oracle

Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

As a manager of the Oracle Cloud Marketplace software engineering team, you will apply your knowledge of software architecture to manage software development tasks associated with developing, debugging or designing software applications, distributed systems, operating systems and databases according to provided design specifications
Own and build a highly available OCI service.
Provide strategic leadership and guidance to a dedicated software development team
Drive the execution and delivery of service roadmap, ensuring projects are completed with the highest quality and within specified timelines.
Engage in hands-on management, including addressing customer issues, managing escalations, and deploying code aligned with change management procedures.
Maintain and enhance technical depth in software development practices and architectural design.
Lead the team in Agile development methodologies in a fast-paced environment

This team is targeting candidates in the U.S. who can work ONSITE in Nashville-TN. Relocation Assistance provided. (This is not a remote position).

BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience
5+ years of people-management experience managing engineers in software development environment.
7+ years’ experience delivering and operating large scale, highly available distributed systems, preferably as a service owner
3+ years of experience leading in large-scale organizations with multiple layers of management
Strong knowledge of Java, GoLang, C++ or C and experience with scripting languages such as Python.
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals.
Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure, storage protocols and standard network architectures.
Strong understanding of databases, storage and distributed persistence technologies.
Strong troubleshooting and performance tuning skills.
Experience building scalable, cloud native distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing services on a public cloud platform (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI)
Experience building multi-tenant, virtualized infrastructure, cloud marketplaces domain.

This leader will be responsible for scaling our multi-session business and developing an industry-leading provisioning and management experience for WorkSpaces Applications that power millions of human users and AI agents. These environments span the full spectrum of customer needs, including desktops, applications, serving knowledge workers, task workers, and automation agents.

As a Sr. SDM in this role, you will champion an automation-first, AI-native mindset to build solutions that dynamically configure environments based on customer needs. This means anticipating the day-to-day needs of administrators and our partners, and embedding those capabilities directly into the architecture, reducing manual effort through thoughtful design, intelligent defaults, and self-service mechanisms. You will meet administrators where they are—building solutions that work for customers who are already cloud-native as well as those beginning their cloud journey.

You will own the operational excellence and security posture of the WorkSpaces Applications fleet. Own the strategy for CAD dashboards and analytics: PPA tracking, run health, signoff QoR trending, tape-out readiness scorecards, and compute/license efficiency metrics.

jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Embedded Software Engineering will lead mission-critical embedded software development for Amazon Leo's satellite bus systems, ensuring our satellite constellation meets aggressive reliability, security, and performance targets from manufacturing through end-of-life operations.

This role owns all embedded software development and systems testing for satellite spacecraft systems — including flight software, real-time operating systems, avionics, and on-orbit software validation. You will architect the software that sits on the satellite, manage the end-to-end software stack to bring up the satellite, and lead comprehensive system testing to ensure spacecraft readiness for launch and on-orbit operations.

This is a highly technical leadership role requiring hands-on embedded software architecture expertise combined with the ability to build and scale high-performing engineering organizations. You will work in constrained hardware environments where computing resources (processing power, memory, power consumption) are severely limited. A satellite has 600+ unique processors — it's like having its own compact data center in space — requiring sophisticated embedded software solutions to coordinate this complexity.

Key job responsibilities

As a group leader, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. The ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

Embedded Software Architecture & Development

Define and implement end-to-end embedded software architecture for satellite bus systems
Lead development of real-time operating system (RTOS) implementations for spacecraft control, including scheduling algorithms and embedded design patterns
Architect Linux OS solutions for satellite systems
Drive hardware bring-up processes: boot, hardware verification, and comprehensive testing
Design and implement control systems, redundancy management, and health check software
Develop and oversee software for custom ASICs and FPGAs used in spacecraft systems
Architect solutions for complex application synchronization (e.g., global time clock syncing)
Address avionics systems challenges unique to spacecraft operations

Satellite Bus Software & Systems Testing

Lead software development for satellite bus systems, including:
Flight software and spacecraft control
Attitude determination and control systems (ADCS)
Power management and distribution
Thermal control systems
Command and data handling
Fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR)
Onboard autonomy and health monitoring
Own systems test strategy and execution for satellite systems, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation frameworks
Lead on-orbit software testing and validation for operational satellites
Establish multi-test environments and continuous test/deployment pipelines
Drive software quality from prototype satellites to production at scale

Description

Amazon's Access Management Services (AMS) organization builds and operates the authorization backbone for all of Amazon. Our services govern who and what can access resources across the company — from group membership and ownership to policy evaluation and contingent authorization, to access lifecycle management. We secure authorization decisions at Amazon scale. Security is our top priority, but we also obsess over availability, latency, and cost-to-serve for the teams that depend on us.

AMS is looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Manager to lead the organization that builds, owns, and operates Amazon's attribute-based access control (ABAC) policy services. Your team defines how authorization policies are expressed, evaluated, and enforced across Amazon — making access decisions for every service and workflow that touches protected resources. You will own Tier-1 services foundational to Amazon's operations while driving a shift from manual, team-by-team policy configuration toward intelligent defaults and automated guardrails that reduce friction for builders without compromising the security bar. Establish cross-business data governance standards — authoring schemas, onboarding processes, and quality gates that allow dozens of businesses to contribute customer signals into a unified system without compromising data integrity.

Job Description

Supports team members in designing and architecting infrastructure and service and shares guidance on practices for reliability and functionality. Monitors health and performance reports. Implements standards for identifying and recommending automation. Ensures team members communicate information and articulate the impact of changes. Serves as a senior management point and shares expectations for documentation. Sets expectations for experimenting with new technology, executing improvements, building site reliability knowledge, and providing clear data.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management:

Supports team members designing and architecting infrastructure and/or service, sharing guidance on practices and terms for reliability and functionality.
Supervises team members and provides direction to ensure accurate forecasting of demands for infrastructure and response to capacity needs, ensuring systems have sufficient resources to handle current and future workloads and identifying resource gaps.
Maintains a collaborative relationship with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements.
Implements expectations for identifying opportunities for prototyping and manages prototyping initiatives (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches.

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:

Monitors data collection, triage, technical analysis, and redirection, ensuring team members maintain and optimize operations and infrastructure reliability.
Provides support to team members monitoring services, ensuring they maintain up-to-date knowledge of performance and document their condition.
Leverages advanced knowledge to aid team members in performing incident response, root cause analyses, and/or maintenance on assigned services (e.g., software installs, version upgrades, security updates, backup and recovery).
Monitors comprehensive health and performance reporting and ensures team members take appropriate actions based on trends in data.
Ensures team members adhere to procedures when performing provisioning to support infrastructure, applications, and services.
Encourages team members to experiment with new approaches for and perform decommissioning (e.g., shutting down servers, removing data from databases) to remove objects that are no longer needed.

Automation:

Implements standards for identifying and recommending opportunities for automation and assesses potential benefits to enhance operational efficiency.
Takes a proactive role in reviewing and offering feedback on design, automation tools, or scripts, acting as a leader during implementation.
Shares strategies for conducting testing on automations to ensure they perform tasks correctly and produce expected results.

Technical Communication and Guidance:

Reviews and provides feedback on release notes and ensures team members communicate comprehensive information about the scale, capacity, security, performance attributes, and requirements of services and technology with customers and immediate and related teams.
Proactively anticipates and articulates the potential impact of infrastructure, feature, and tool changes, considering their impact across team operations.
Serves as a resource to team members on what information to communicate and how to communicate.

Serves as a senior management escalation point for incidents and complex issues arising within Oracle services.
Monitors the resolution of technical issues spanning multiple services, ensuring effective investigation and debugging techniques are leveraged to achieve SLOs (service level objectives).
Shares expectations for documenting incidents performing root cause analyses, guiding team members to capture essential information for analysis and future reference.
Implements guidelines for post-mortem procedures to prevent incident reoccurrence.
Ensures team members adhere to service level agreements (SLAs) made with customers.

Sets expectations for conducting experiments and evaluating cutting-edge tools and technologies to optimize infrastructure performance and reliability, taking proactive steps to adhere to security standards.
Manages and contributes to the prioritization of initiatives to improve performance bottlenecks and deployments, ensuring efficient resource usage, speed, and scalability.

Leverages analyses and data from teams to contribute to business development decisions (e.g., design changes).

Planning & Execution:

Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. jobs.description:
Description

Every AWS workshop, GameDay, or any other kind of hands-on event a customer touches starts as content that someone has to create, ensure it is safe and high-quality, and then find a way deliver at scale. This role owns that entire lifecycle. Workshop Studio is the service the AWS Tech Field uses to give customers hands-on experience with AWS, powering ~97% of hands-on sessions at re:Invent and the global Summit series. In 2025 alone, the Field ran nearly 50,000 events globally, reaching over 710,000 participants. Behind the platform sits one of the largest fleets of AWS accounts on the planet, along with a Gen AI content scanner handling over a million quality and security scans a month before content ever reaches a customer.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to own content quality and delivery end-to-end. This is a manager-of-managers role leading several distinct teams, each with its own area of focus: the engineering teams behind Workshop Studio, spanning content authoring and publishing, event creation and delivery, and the underlying AWS account fleet operations; the team that builds the Gen AI content scanner that evaluates content for quality and security, scaling review processes without adding human reviewers; and a content quality program that ties these together, defining what the quality bar is, partnering with business leaders across their domains to identify top-performing content, and setting the strategy for how that content is scaled and through which channels. Together they own how technical content is created, how its quality and security bar is enforced, and how it is delivered to customers, including self-service, hands-on experiences in Amazon Builder Center, AWS's primary customer-facing community engagement platform. Because you own the full lifecycle rather than a single piece of it, you have the autonomy and agency to define the North Star and charter for this business and build a cohesive strategy across all of your teams.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about owning large-scale, always-on services and building leaders. You are equally comfortable setting a multi-year vision and diving into the operational reality of a service thousands of Solutions Architects and AWS customers depend on daily. Gen AI runs throughout this space, and there are several areas of active investment. Human review alone cannot keep pace with the volume of content moving through these systems, so Gen AI does the heavy lifting of evaluating quality and in the fullness of time, security, at scale. We are automating event support to shorten response times and put resolution directly in the hands of event operators. We are also investing in content generation to make high-quality content easier to produce, which in turn streamlines the review it has to pass. For a leader looking to deepen their team's AI impact on a critical, high-visibility service, there is significant room to invest and grow.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content quality & delivery charter: Own the North Star for a business that spans content creation, quality/security validation, and delivery. Working with your product management partners, set the technical vision and multi-year roadmap for a lifecycle you own from end to end.
Lead a multi-team organization: Lead multiple engineering and program teams, coaching managers, setting engineering standards, and driving delivery against organizational goals.
Scale content quality with Gen AI: Invest in the systems and programs that keep quality and security scaling with content volume rather than headcount, moving review upstream into content creators' pipelines.

Operational excellence: Set the bar for availability, quality, and security across services thousands of Solutions Architects and hundreds of thousands of customers depend on.

Together they form an ecosystem that augments the field through learning and enablement. jobs.title: Sr Release Manager, Design Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

We are seeking a highly technical Design Portfolio Manager to join our GDSCM team, focusing on the Basis of Design (BOD) and Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) programs. This role requires deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines and the ability to evaluate complex design changes across 300+ in-flight projects.

As a Design portfolio Manager, you will serve as a technical expert evaluating design change requests across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, architectural, controls, plumbing, fire protection, and thermal systems. You will conduct feasibility analyses, coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across all disciplines, and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of design changes from initiation through implementation.

You will work closely with Design Engineering, Construction Management, Procurement, Finance, and Product teams to ensure design changes are properly vetted, funded, and executed.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Design Evaluation

Evaluate complex design changes across multiple engineering disciplines including electrical power distribution, mechanical cooling systems, structural loads, civil site work, architectural layouts, controls systems, plumbing infrastructure, and fire protection systems
Analyze technical specifications, construction drawings, equipment datasheets, and system integration requirements to assess design change feasibility and impact
Understand and explain the complexity of data center designs including power distribution from utility to rack level, cooling system architectures, backup power systems, and building infrastructure
Identify technical dependencies and cross-discipline impacts when evaluating proposed design changes
Assess constructability, maintainability, and operational implications of design modifications
Review and validate technical calculations including electrical load calculations, cooling capacity requirements, structural load analysis, and hydraulic calculations

Design Change Management

Manage portfolio of design changes across multiple in-flight projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical requirements
Conduct feasibility analyses and production readiness assessments for proposed design changes, evaluating technical risk, schedule impact, and cost implications
Coordinate technical reviews with principal engineers across mechanical, electrical, structural, civil, architectural, controls, plumbing, and fire protection disciplines
Develop and maintain implementation plans, tracking design change execution from approval through site deployment
Present design change recommendations and cost implications to senior leadership, clearly articulating technical complexity and business impact
Evaluate design improvements and innovations, assessing their applicability across the global portfolio

Cross-Discipline Collaboration

Partner with Electrical Engineers on power distribution design, generator sizing, UPS configurations, switchgear specifications, and high-voltage systems
Collaborate with Mechanical Engineers on cooling system design, HVAC configurations, piping layouts, and thermal management strategies
Work with Structural Engineers on foundation design, seismic requirements, equipment support structures, and building loads
Engage with Civil Engineers on site grading, stormwater management, utility routing, and site infrastructure
Coordinate with Architectural teams on building layouts, space planning, and building envelope design
Interface with Controls Engineers on building management systems, monitoring systems, and automation strategies
Partner with Fire Protection Engineers on fire suppression systems, detection systems, and life safety requirements

Stakeholder Coordination

Partner with Design Management teams to understand project-specific requirements, constraints, and technical challenges
Collaborate with Finance teams on cost validation, funding strategies, and budget tracking for design changes
Work with Construction Management and Procurement teams to assess schedule impacts, supply chain constraints, and constructability
Engage with Product and Solutions teams to evaluate new equipment, emerging technologies, and design approaches
Coordinate with Commissioning teams to ensure design changes support testing and startup requirements

Process Improvement

Identify opportunities to streamline design change workflows and reduce execution timelines while maintaining technical rigor
Develop and maintain technical documentation including standard operating procedures, design standards, technical specifications, and RACI matrices
Contribute to automation initiatives and tooling improvements for design change management
Support integration of cost validation frameworks and bulk funding mechanisms
Drive continuous improvement in technical review processes and design quality standards

Program Execution

Track and report on design change metrics including approval timelines, cost avoidance, implementation status, and technical quality
Maintain design change databases and dashboards for cross-functional visibility
Support BOD release planning and coordination to minimize redesign impacts
Participate in weekly leadership reviews presenting program status, key decisions, and technical recommendations

About The Team

The Global Design Standards and Change Management (GDSCM) organization within Data Center Engineering is responsible for establishing and maintaining design standards across the global data center portfolio. Our team manages three mission-critical programs:

Basis of Design (BOD) Establishes and governs the foundational technical standards for all global data center designs, ensuring consistency and quality across the portfolio.

Programmatic Design Change Management (PDCM) Manages design change requests across 300+ in-flight projects.

360 Equipment Qualification Program (360 EQP) Qualifies equipment and technologies for deployment across the global portfolio, evaluating emerging solutions and driving standardization of critical systems.

Together, these programs deliver capacity across the AMER, APAC, and EMEA regions.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. jobs.title: Sr. Value Engineering Manager, Value Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?

We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.

Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.

Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.

Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.

Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.

Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.

Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.

Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.

Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.

Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About The Team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within at least two disciplines within the construction industry, such as Contracting, Owners Representation, Architecture, Design and Engineering, Commercial Development, analysis and control of construction costs or similar
Experience in project management in construction and contracts management
AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, 5G RAN – Core Systems Software Architecture
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver high-speed, low-latency broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the design, development, and lab integration of real-time communications software enabling robust, standards-compliant connectivity between gNodeB platforms and Multi-Operator Core Network (MOCN) environments.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP control-plane and data-plane protocols, extensive experience with NGC and NGU interfaces, and the ability to architect, partition, and guide the implementation of complex software systems. Equally important, this leader will build, develop, and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and career growth.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years experience developing interfaces to 5G Core networks, a strong understanding of RRC signaling, Multi-PLMN broadcast configuration, and PLMN operations, as well as practical expertise with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and physical integration of RAN and transport systems in a lab environment. This Senior Manager will play a critical leadership role in hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers across multiple levels while driving execution of complex technical programs.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect and design the full software stack enabling real-time control-plane and data-plane communication between gNodeB and MOCN environments in support of Amazon Leo's satellite-terrestrial integration objectives.
Define software partitioning, module boundaries, and interface specifications for NGC, NGU, RRC, and Multi-PLMN broadcast components.
Lead development of 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity.
Oversee integration of transport technologies, including MPLS and segment routing, into the RAN–Core connectivity architecture.
Drive troubleshooting and performance optimization across NGC, NGU, and RRC layers.
Author technical specifications, architecture documents, and interface control documents (ICDs) for internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving MOCN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned with Amazon Leo's roadmap.

Lab Integration & Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing

Lead lab activities including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test framework development, physical interface validation, and system-level integration testing.
Develop and validate HIL test frameworks ensuring accurate modeling of physical interfaces, fronthaul/backhaul connectivity, and multi-operator core interactions.
Oversee lab infrastructure planning, equipment procurement, and test environment configuration to support rapid prototyping and validation cycles.
Drive lab-based integration of RAN, transport, and core network components, ensuring end-to-end system alignment and standards compliance.
Collaborate with RF, RAN, and Core engineering teams in the lab to validate satellite-terrestrial network interoperability.

Team Building & People Development

Build and scale a high-performing software engineering team through strategic hiring, including conducting phone screens, on-site interviews, and bar raiser activities.
Develop individual growth plans for each engineer, identifying technical and leadership development opportunities aligned with career aspirations.
Mentor engineers at all levels, providing regular coaching on technical depth, system design thinking, and Amazon's Leadership Principles.
Foster a culture of continuous learning through technical brown bags, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Identify and develop future technical leaders within the team, creating pathways for promotion and increased scope.
Conduct regular 1:1s focused on career development, skill gap analysis, and stretch assignments that accelerate engineer growth.
Create an inclusive team environment that encourages innovation, calculated risk-taking, and learning from failure.
Drive organizational health metrics including retention, engagement, and internal mobility.

Own the technical roadmap and execution plan, driving delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
Operate with a bias for action while maintaining the highest bar for quality and safety in satellite communications systems.
Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, design documents) to senior leadership.
Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
Demonstrate Ownership by treating the team's mission as your own, and Earn Trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.

5+ years of people management, managing engineers experience

jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Datacenter Security Systems leads the global implementation of security controls within AWS datacenters. From creation through datacenter retirement, this role is accountable for delivering innovative security controls that meet the business needs for scale and speed. This role coordinates across design, construction, networking, and partner software teams to deliver physical and logical controls through software and process innovation, and is accountable for both building innovative solutions and operating them at fleet scale.

Infrastructure Security is looking for an experienced Director of Software Development to transform how we create and maintain datacenter security controls across Amazon. You will operate Tier-1 services foundational to AWS datacenter operations and define the approach for deploying security at the speed of modular builds while continuously raising the security bar across all of AWS.

This opportunity is multi-disciplinary, requiring depth of knowledge and experience in security solutions, software development, building design, product management, AWS services, and cost control. It requires a leader who can deliver security solutions within the context of business outcomes and drive iterative improvement in an environment where both the threat landscape and the pace of construction are changing rapidly.

You will draw from deep and broad technical expertise to guide software engineers, principal engineers, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence. You will apply AI and machine learning to transform how your systems operate: from computer vision that performs real-time authorization decisions, to automated triage and anomaly detection, to intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort. This role has substantial visibility with senior executives and is built for a leader who thrives on pace, ambiguity, and building high-performing teams from the ground up.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end design, delivery, and operation of datacenter security systems globally, including access control, video surveillance, perimeter detection, and the software platforms that manage them
Transform cameras into active assurance mechanisms through computer vision that performs real-time physical authorization linked to work order systems, reducing reliance on manual observation for access verification
Deliver security infrastructure that ships at modular build speed: persistent hardware from construction through operations, standardized security kits, and zero-touch provisioning that eliminates per-site engineering effort
Build and operate a Tier-1 service owning the complete lifecycle of every networked security IoT device globally: onboarding, firmware management, credential rotation, health monitoring, and performance telemetry
Drive security economics that deliver equivalent or better outcomes at lower cost per site as the fleet scales
Define and deliver AI-driven capabilities including computer vision for real-time authorization, automated triage and anomaly detection, generative AI for development acceleration, and intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort
Lead and scale a high-performing engineering organization spanning software development, systems engineering, hardware engineering, and program management

A day in the life

This role spends most days working hand in hand with datacenter operations and datacenter engineering teams. You will advocate for logical security controls across AWS service teams to meet the demands of a modular datacenter build plan, ensuring that every layer of the defense-in-depth continuum is instrumented, measured, and delivering against the security bar at the speed the business requires.

About The Team

The Infrastructure Security Team is accountable for ensuring that the foundation of AWS operates and scales securely. This team is responsible for the security of the hardware supply chain, AWS datacenters, and the AWS network. We build operational security solutions that are critical to the operations of AWS infrastructure, including identity management, security telemetry and threat analysis, hardware component validation, and ensuring third-party suppliers meet the AWS security bar.

Track record of delivering innovative cloud-based applications and services at scale

jobs.description:
Description

Amazon pays millions of vendors, suppliers, and partners across every business line, in every geography we operate. Payables Tech owns platforms that make this work: invoice management, payable processing, vendor experience, process automation, fraud detection, and the data services underneath it all.

Our systems move payment volumes that would rank among the largest national economies by GDP. The job is changing rapidly. AI is transforming finance operations, automating routine transactional work so teams can focus on higher-judgment problems. Our vendors are deploying AI-enabled tools to manage payables, submit disputes, and reconcile accounts. Static payment rules are being replaced by ML-driven risk models. Our engineering teams are organizing for AI-native velocity, with small pods of subject matter experts and engineers orchestrating AI-generated features in tight loops. Our vision requires a leader who will drive these transformations, not ride them.

We are looking for a leader responsible for core Amazon Accounts Payable (AP) platforms., leading a 150-person engineering organization. This leader will be part of FinAuto's senior leadership team and own invoice ingestion and validation, payable computation and disposition, payee data management, risk and fraud detection, and the APIs and agent surfaces that vendors and internal customers use to interact with these systems.

Key job responsibilities

Own the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for Amazon's AP platforms, feeding directly into FinAuto's 3-year strategy
Lead a distributed engineering organization of 150
Deliver ambitious new capabilities: agentic process automation for defect resolution, touchless document processing, ML-based payment risk scoring, and new modes of vendor interaction and self-service
Drive engineering transformation: pioneer AI-native development practices, organize around small outcome-focused, cross-functional teams, and redefine what great engineering looks like for your organization
Maintain operational excellence for payment-critical systems requiring exacting precision, high availability, and regulatory compliance across dozens of countries
Build partnerships with Finance Operations, Controllership, Product, and business line leaders, as well as peer organizations up and downstream
Independently represent the organization with VP-level stakeholders daily

A day in the life

This role leads simultaneous transformation in what gets built (autonomous payments, agentic automation, agent-to-agent commerce), how it gets built (AI-native engineering, small empowered pods), and who builds it. Daily work involves making bold technical bets on distributed systems, navigating change across hundreds of engineers, and demonstrating what's possible — not mandating. You operate with a startup mindset: reducing complexity, driving standards that accelerate building, and moving faster than customers expect. Requires deep technical depth, organizational vision, and clear written communication.

About The Team

FinAuto is one of Amazon's largest fintech organizations. We work with every part of Amazon to capture, compute, transact, and report financial events. Payables Tech owns the platforms that pay Amazon's vendors, from the world's largest suppliers to individual app developers, accurately and on time, across every business and geography.

We process billions of financial events annually through systems that must be precise, fast, and resilient. We are in the middle of a transformation driven by AI on two fronts: what our platforms do and how we build them.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering or related field
12+ years of increasing responsibility leading large engineering teams
Strong knowledge of architecting and operating distributed systems at massive scale
Multidisciplinary experience across software development, product management, program management, and quality automation
Experience with domain solutions involving risks that require exacting precision, high availability, and low latency

10+ years leading engineering organizations of 150+ people while remaining close to critical technical decisions
5+ years interacting regularly with senior level executives
Experience applying AI/ML to production business processes at scale (production, not pilots)
Experience leading teams through transitions to AI-driven development practices
Background in financial systems, payments, or fintech

Exceptional written communication

jobs.description:
In today’s world of constant global security challenges, innovation in defense is no luxury. After years of budget cuts, military personnel needs to train and work with inadequate and insufficient equipment. We have an opportunity to change that.

At Intelic, we are a group of highly committed professionals building one of the fastest-growing start-ups based in Amsterdam. We create advanced software for unmanned systems in the Defence sector. As a software company at our core, we build intelligence that gives unmanned platforms the speed, coordination and reliability that critical missions demand. Our technology ensures that decisions are made with accuracy when it matters most.

What You Will Do

As Head of Engineering, you ensure our engineering organisation runs efficiently, predictably, and with high technical quality. Your main focus is on designing, implementing, and optimising software development processes that help our teams deliver reliable, mission-critical software at scale. You’ll work closely with the leads of our six multidisciplinary teams, whom you directly manage, to streamline workflows, improve collaboration, and remove friction in how we build, test, and deliver software.

The Head of Engineering reports directly to the CTO and ensures that engineering execution aligns with the overall technology vision. In this role, you work closely with the Head of Product and the Head of Design to translate discovery insights and business requirements into well-designed, scalable, and systematic solutions. You’ll help shape the way we grow and support our engineering teams, defining clear roles, fostering mentorship, and ensuring that people management happens effectively within each team. While you won’t directly manage every engineer, you will set the standards for how technical leadership, feedback, and professional growth are practiced across the organization. As the hierarchical manager of the six team leads, you ensure that leadership expectations are clear and consistently upheld.

This role suits someone who is deeply technical but thrives on building structure, someone who understands how great engineering cultures emerge from clear processes, shared standards, and continuous improvement.

• Designing, implementing, and refining Agile/Scrum development processes to improve efficiency, predictability, and product quality
• Collaborating with team leads to ensure consistent planning, estimation, and delivery practices across all engineering teams
• Driving adoption of clear engineering standards and robust CI/CD practices
• Aligning architecture and technical direction with business priorities and product goals
• Facilitating effective communication and collaboration across teams and disciplines
• Monitoring delivery performance and identifying opportunities for improvement through metrics and retrospectives
• Acting as a bridge between leadership, product, and engineering to ensure clarity and alignment
• Providing hierarchical leadership, coaching, and accountability for the six engineering team leads

What You Will Bring

As a technical leader, you combine a clear strategic vision with the ability to dive deep into complex engineering challenges. You know how to guide teams through rapid growth, keep quality high, and create an environment where engineers do their best work.
• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, including 5+ years leading multiple development teams in a fast-growing environment
• Proven experience in and passion for designing and improving software development processes (Agile/Scrum) to increase efficiency, predictability, and quality

• Skilled at introducing structure and consistency across teams without adding unnecessary complexity
• Excellent communication and organisational skills, with a focus on clarity, accountability, and collaboration
• Nice to have: Background in mission-critical or high-stakes software (e.g., defense, aerospace, robotics)

Our Tech Stack

• Backend: Rust (85–95%) & Python
• Frontend: Svelte, TypeScript, Tailwind
• Simulation: Unreal Engine 5
• CI/CD: GitHub Actions
• Containerization: Docker

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

• Clear, scalable engineering processes implemented and consistently followed across all teams
• Improved predictability and delivery velocity through better planning and communication
• High cross-team collaboration and transparency in progress and decision-making
• Reduced technical debt through stronger engineering discipline and testing practices
• A culture of continuous improvement, where teams identify and act on efficiency gains

Why Join Intelic

• Talented Team: Work with leading engineers and domain experts shaping the future of autonomous systems.
• Hands-On Impact: See the direct real-world outcomes of your work in field tests and operational deployments.
• Growth Stage Momentum: Join at a moment where your leadership will have lasting influence.

What We Offer

• Travel allowance coverage
• A flexible pension plan
• The opportunity to contribute directly to our growing company’s culture and operations
• A modern office at NDSM Plein in Amsterdam Noord
• A corporate membership at Urban Sports
• 25 vacation days + 8% holiday allowance
• Be part of our success through a Stock Appreciation Rights program
• Possibility to lease a bike through ‘Lease a Bike’

We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you. If you have any questions, please contact our recruiter Liliia at liliia@intelic.ai

AWS has formed a new Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) team dedicated to embedding AI Engineers and Scientists directly inside strategic enterprise customer environments to help design, build, and deploy AI-powered production systems. Description

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our

customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon is looking for an energetic, detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team in the Greater Milan Area. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers.

Also expected from the CE is the ability to manage large scale impacting projects and new region support from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, procurement, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

The CE directs, trains and supports EOTs in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems.

The role will be based in the Greater Milan area, however flexibility is required to travel to other locations within the EMEA region if required.

Key job responsibilities

Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in data centers
Assist in the design and build out of new facilities
Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center region and work OT hours as needed to support site stability
Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and assisting in recruiting efforts for the same
Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
Utilize internal Change Management Systems to manage building workflows
MV/LV Isolation to facilitate MV maintenance
Provide metric availability reporting on a weekly basis

The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate the following competencies and behaviors:

Ability to solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
Aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving.
Ability to maintain SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and immediate response.
Proven experience of reading SLDs and control schematics.
Ability to follow support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries into a trouble ticket system.
Shows good judgment and instincts in decision making.
Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
Ability to demonstrate their ability to take ownership of technical issues brought to them by their customer base

Physical Requirements

Work at heights and from ladders.
Perform physical tasks
Work in a noisy environment with ear protection

**To apply, please submit a detailed copy of your CV in English**

Working location:

Our data centers are located in remote areas outside Milan, where access via public transport may be limited. Therefore, a valid driving license is required for this role.

Work Schedule

This is a 100% in-person onsite position due to the hands-on nature of managing mission-critical infrastructure. The role follows standard working hours (8 AM – 5 PM Milan time from Mo - Fri) with no shift work.

Working Language

Please be advised that the interview process at AWS will be conducted in English, as we are an international team based in the Greater Milan area.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. jobs.title: Senior Manager, High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) spans 120 Availability Zones within 38 geographic Regions around the world, with announced plans for 10 more Availability Zones and three more Regions — making AWS the most extensive global cloud infrastructure provider and one of the fastest-growing enterprise technology companies ever. Amazon's AWS Data Centers (DC) are a major component of worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure and are industry-leading examples of mission-critical facilities.

Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost-effective DC facilities. We are responsible for achieving world-class uptime for our customers and developing a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet AWS's growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs.

As an Engineering Manager at AWS, you will have the opportunity to impact changes in our current design and establish design procedures and protocols for future systems. AWS Engineering is responsible for the design of all electrical and mechanical systems within all Amazon DCs worldwide. The team works directly with operations, security teams, field engineering, and construction management to implement designs that are functional, practical, and innovative.

The team is seeking a Senior High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering Manager with demonstrated expertise in the design, analysis, and deployment of high-voltage direct current distribution systems, with specific emphasis on 800VDC bus architectures or comparable voltage classes (e.g., ±400V, 600VDC, 1500VDC) in industrial, utility, transportation, renewable energy, or large-scale power infrastructure applications.

This is a highly specialized, foundational engineering role on a newly formed team chartered to design and develop a next-generation, facility-scale High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) power architecture purpose-built for Generative AI compute loads. This is a greenfield, industry-defining effort — reference designs at this scale and application do not broadly exist in the data center industry. As such, we are seeking engineers with deep domain expertise in high-power HVDC and power conversion systems who bring the intellectual foundation and engineering rigor to translate that expertise into a novel data center context. Direct data center experience is welcomed but is not a prerequisite for this role

You will be responsible for delivery of projects, applying design quality controls, and providing technical guidance to team members. As a subject matter expert, you will be responsible for the design of prototypical DC facilities, localization of conceptual innovations, solving large-scale implementation issues, and building strong relationships with the regional industry. This role represents a rare opportunity to define a new class of data center power infrastructure from the ground up. The successful candidate will not be expected to know all the answers on day one — they will be expected to have the engineering depth, intellectual rigor, and collaborative mindset to help build them.

Anticipated travel: up to 25%

Key job responsibilities

Develop strategic solutions that meet or exceed quality requirements and fall within budgetary and redundancy requirements
Conceive, initiate, and lead projects with widespread impact on infrastructure design, innovation, and implementation
Set the standard for engineering, test, and best practices; drive process improvements across the organization
Decompose complex problems into straightforward and actionable solutions
Be a leader within the group and within internal and external teams that support our data centers
Provide technical oversight of the Regional Electrical and Mechanical Basis of Design (BOD)
Serve as a technical advisor for AWS datacenter electrical and mechanical designs
Work with internal teams to understand user requirements
Work with local agencies having jurisdiction and certification agencies to ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes

You might spend your morning reviewing electrical and mechanical designs with your engineering team, then transition to presenting a business case to leadership on a new cooling technology that could reduce costs without compromising reliability. Later, you could be collaborating with construction teams to solve implementation challenges on an active project, or meeting with local agencies to ensure our designs meet all compliance requirements. You'll also mentor engineers on your team, helping them develop their expertise in mission-critical systems while fostering a culture of creative problem-solving and continuous improvement.

We are a global engineering organization dedicated to designing resilient, cost-effective data center facilities that support AWS's rapid growth. Our team includes Architects, Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Control Engineers who work collaboratively to challenge conventional thinking and develop innovative solutions. We partner closely with operations, security, field engineering, and construction management teams to ensure our designs are not only technically sound but also practical and implementable. Our vision is to establish design procedures and protocols that set industry standards while meeting the evolving demands of cloud infrastructure. You'll be joining a group that values technical excellence, creative problem-solving, and strong cross-functional relationships with both internal teams and regional industry partners.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead multiple engineering teams building mission-critical systems that power AWS's global infrastructure supply chain. Your engineering decisions will directly impact how AWS delivers and operates data centers worldwide, ensuring hundreds of thousands of customers have seamless access to cloud services.

In this role, you'll define the technical vision and engineering culture for teams responsible for core SCos subsystems. You'll balance immediate delivery needs with long-term strategic investments, setting standards for operational excellence while developing the next generation of engineering leaders. If you're passionate about solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, building high-performing teams, and driving innovation that keeps the cloud running, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Lead and develop multiple software development teams, including managing other engineering managers, to deliver scalable infrastructure solutions that support AWS global data center operations
Define and execute the long-term technical strategy, resource planning, and organizational structure for your teams, making critical decisions on hiring, team composition, and succession planning that enable sustainable growth
Establish and drive operational excellence across your organization by implementing mechanisms for monitoring, alarming, incident response, and continuous improvement that ensure high availability and performance
Partner with Principal Engineers, Applied Scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to align architectural decisions with business objectives and product roadmaps, ensuring solutions meet both current and future needs
Set and balance organizational goals that optimize for customer outcomes, engineering quality, and employee development while fostering an inclusive environment where team members grow their technical and leadership capabilities

A day in the life

You'll start your day reviewing operational metrics across your teams, identifying opportunities to improve system performance and reliability. You'll spend time in technical design reviews, partnering with Principal Engineers to evaluate architectural tradeoffs for new features. Throughout the day, you'll coach your engineering managers on handling team challenges, conduct one-on-ones with senior engineers to support their growth, and facilitate cross-team collaboration sessions. You'll also work on strategic planning documents that shape the multi-year roadmap for SCos, balancing technical innovation with business priorities.

About The Team

The AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team builds the software systems that orchestrate AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain at global scale. Our mission is to ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time to support customer demand. We work on complex challenges involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly impact AWS's ability to scale.

Our team values innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive better solutions, and we invest heavily in developing our engineers and leaders. As AWS continues its rapid growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while building and leading world-class engineering teams.

new_jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering Management
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, thinkers, and problem-solvers focused on delivering scalable, AI-powered software products that improve how organizations work. We value clean architecture, intuitive experiences, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer plays an important role in shaping the quality, reliability, and long-term success of our products.

About The Team

The Service Operations Business Unit brings together IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), and CMDB capabilities on the ServiceNow Platform. This product engineering organization builds the software that helps customers deliver resilient, intelligent, and efficient enterprise services.

The Service Operations product portfolio connects incident, request, fulfillment, infrastructure visibility, service mapping, trusted configuration data, automation, and AIOps into a unified operating model. By combining service delivery with operational intelligence and trusted operational context, these products help customers move toward proactive, AI-assisted, and increasingly self-healing operations at enterprise scale.

Together, these capabilities help customers modernize how they deliver and operate services, improve reliability, reduce manual effort, and drive measurable productivity outcomes on a single platform.

What You Get To Do In This Role

As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams that architect and build assistive and autonomous AI-native products to usher customers (IT departments using our IT service and operations management applications) into an agentic-first era. The work will span large-scale distributed systems, data ingestion, context creation and utilization, agentic harnesses, cost optimization, and agentic feedback loops to ensure value realization for our customers.

This role requires people leadership, thought leadership, deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a keen understanding of the scientific method to ship and refine real product through iterative experimentation. You will be accountable for the growth, health, and delivery outcomes of your teams.

Responsibilities Include

Lead and grow the engineering teams responsible for assigned problem areas within ITSM/ITOM products, working with product and engineering leaders to understand blockers and opportunities around AI-native evolution and value realization.
Own technical strategy and delivery for your teams. Set architectural direction, hold the bar on quality and reliability, and stay close enough to the work to validate hypotheses through evidence, not theory.
Hire, coach, and develop engineers, tech leads, and managers. Build inclusive, high-performing teams with clear career paths and durable ownership.
Drive evidence-based decision-making: formulate hypotheses, run experiments, measure outcomes, and use data to guide architectural decisions and product direction.
Lead the evolution of current solutions toward AI-native capabilities—identifying where agentic patterns, data utilization, or autonomous workflows can unlock customer value—and translate those recommendations into staffed, executable work.
Identify and address value realization gaps in agentic products that exist but aren’t delivering expected outcomes. Diagnose root causes (architecture, UX, data quality, feedback loops, cost) and direct targeted improvements.
Establish architecture patterns, engineering standards, and operating rhythms specific to your problem domain. Document tradeoffs, rationale, and implementation guidance to help teams move faster and make consistent decisions.
Collaborate across ITSM/ITOM engineering teams to share learnings, validate approaches, and accelerate adoption of patterns that work.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success — aligning on roadmap and release readiness, meeting security and compliance requirements, and feeding field and customer signal back into engineering priorities.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

15+ years of related engineering experience, including 5+ years leading and managing engineering teams (including managers or team leads), or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems, enterprise platforms, workflow systems, data-intensive products, integration frameworks, or cloud-scale infrastructure.
Deep understanding of system design for scale, reliability, observability, fault tolerance, data quality, security, and production readiness.
Strong technical depth in Java, Python, or similar programming languages.
Proven ability to define technical direction, influence architecture across teams, and translate ambiguous product strategy into executable engineering plans.
Demonstrated success hiring, developing, and retaining engineers and engineering leaders, and managing performance, career growth, and team health.
Ability to lead through formal authority and technical credibility alike, building alignment across peer engineering, Product, Design, Security, Operations, Sales, and Customer Success organizations.
Strong judgment in balancing long-term architecture with pragmatic execution, customer impact, engineering velocity, and business priorities.
Experience mentoring senior engineers, raising engineering standards, and building reusable patterns that create leverage across teams.
Experience with AI-powered products, automation platforms, AI-assisted workflows, or agentic systems is strongly preferred.
Ability to reason about AI-assisted enterprise workflows, including data quality, workflow correctness, evaluation, observability, safety controls, and human-in-the-loop review.
Experience with enterprise service management, IT operations, CMDB, discovery, service mapping, AIOps, observability, workflow automation, endpoint management, or operational intelligence is a strong plus.
Experience working with large-scale enterprise customers, production systems, and complex migration or modernization efforts is a plus.
Why Join Us
Shape the AI-native future of the Service Operations Business Unit product portfolio on the ServiceNow Platform.
Build and lead the teams delivering foundational product and platform capabilities that help enterprises deliver, operate, automate, and continuously improve services at scale.
Define how AI agents, automation, operational data, and human workflows come together to create safer, more reliable, and more productive enterprise operations.
Collaborate with teams that value craftsmanship, quality, innovation, accountability, and meaningful customer impact.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $221,200 - $387,100
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals.
