new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.  
Roku is changing how the world watches TV
Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.
From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

About the role
  Software engineering is at an inflection point — and Enterprise Engineering at Roku sits right at the center of it. Applications are increasingly built to plug into AI platforms — exposing their capabilities as services for agents rather than standing alone as siloed apps — and the once-clear lines between engineering disciplines are blurring, rewarding versatile engineers who can work across the stack and own outcomes end to end. At the same time, AI is raising the bar on what a lean engineering organization can deliver.  
Roku is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead the organization that builds the custom applications, integrations, enterprise data, AI and agentic capabilities, and productivity platforms that power how the company runs. This is a senior leadership role: you’ll set the technical vision, shape our architecture for an AI-native future, and make Enterprise Engineering’s systems agent-ready — all while championing engineering excellence in quality, security, and speed.  
Reporting to the VP of Enterprise Engineering, you will lead a global organization across teams in the US, UK, and India. You’ll own the software engineering organization building Roku’s custom enterprise applications, integrations, and enterprise data; Productivity Engineering, the platforms and workflows that shape how thousands of employees work each day; and enterprise AI enablement — the AI-enabled capabilities that let our systems and our people operate with far greater leverage.  
The ideal candidate is a builder-architect and a transformation leader. You have deep, current expertise in AI and software architecture and a clear point of view on where software is heading, and you have repeatedly reshaped teams and lifted engineering standards to meet that direction. You care as much about how work gets done — the architecture, the rigor, the ways of working — as about what gets shipped.  
For California Only - The estimated annual salary for this position is between $650,000 - $750,000 annually. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. 

What you’ll be doing
  Technical Direction & Architecture

Set the technical vision and standards for the software engineering organization that builds Roku’s custom enterprise applications, integrations, and enterprise data.  

Advance our architecture and engineering practices — driving cloud-native design, strong engineering and security discipline, and fast, reliable delivery.  

AI & the Agentic Platform

Drive our  enterprise AI enablement  strategy — building the reusable foundations for agent-ready systems (identity-aware MCP services, reusable skills, eval practices, and a governed  context layer) and enabling teams across the organization to build, adopt, and operate AI capabilities themselves.  

Lead the organization’s shift to AI-first engineering: drive team-wide AI adoption, create the psychological safety for teams to experiment and learn, redesign workflows around AI rather than bolting it on, and establish standards for the quality and accountability of AI-assisted work.  

Organization & Transformation

Reshape team topology around outcomes as the boundaries between engineering disciplines blur, evolving the org toward versatile, product-aligned teams.  

Build, coach, and uplift a high-performing, geographically distributed engineering team, and serve as a thought partner to executive leadership.  

Enterprise Scope & Governance

Own Productivity Engineering: the platforms, workflows, and tools that shape how thousands of employees collaborate, execute, and make decisions.  

Partner on the architecture and execution of major enterprise tentpole initiatives that span multiple systems and teams.  

Operate with the governance, security, audit, and compliance discipline (including SOX) that enterprise systems require.  

We’re excited if you have
  1 5 + years building and leading software engineering teams, including significant experience leading managers and/or senior engineers in an organization of scale.  

Deep, current expertise in cloud architecture and software engineering, with the judgment to set architectural direction and go as deep as a problem requires — whether as a hands-on architect or leading through strong managers.  

Personal, current fluency with the agentic engineering toolchain — conversational AI and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) used across the full software development lifecycle — with the judgment to drive an agent, verify its output, and lead by example. Depth in LLM-based applications, agentic workflows, MCP integration, and eval-driven development.  

A track record of raising engineering standards in an existing organization — modernizing architecture, embedding secure-by-design practices, and improving quality, rigor, and agility.  

Conviction and experience in organizational design, including reshaping teams around outcomes and evolving operating models.  

Experience with enterprise or internal platforms and the governance, security, and compliance that come with them; large-scale enterprise system modernization is a strong plus.  

Change leadership: a demonstrated ability to move an organization to new, AI-enabled ways of working and to protect strategic capacity against the gravity of run-the-business work.  

Exceptional executive presence, a data-driven mindset, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.  

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.  
We value your AI skills if you’ve built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks — and you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.  
What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?
Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?
Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations
Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

What should I know about Roku's culture?
Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 
We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 
To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines is a suite of fully managed, high-performance analytics services built on popular open-source frameworks, enabling customers to process, analyze, and derive insights from massive datasets with speed, flexibility, and cost efficiency. Open Data Analytics Engines make it easy for organizations to run petabyte-scale analytics using familiar open-source tools without the operational burden of managing infrastructure.

AWS Open Data Analytics Engines encompasses services purpose-built for large-scale data processing, interactive querying, real-time streaming, and machine learning workloads. The platform leverages open-source engines such as Apache Spark, Presto/Trino, Apache Flink, and Apache Hive, delivering seamless integration with the broader AWS ecosystem. Compute and storage are decoupled, enabling elastic scaling, fine-grained cost optimization, and support for diverse data lake architectures.

As Director of Engineering for Open Data Analytics Engines, you will lead a group of top talent in advancing the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, features, and performance. You'll drive the design, development, and operation of next-generation open-source analytics services on AWS, shaping the future of how customers run large-scale queries in the cloud.

Key job responsibilities

Grow and lead a software development organization responsible for building key AWS analytics services based on open-source engines.

Drive the design, implementation, testing, and deployment of managed analytics services spanning batch processing, interactive queries, and real-time streaming.

Own the strategy and technical roadmap for innovations in engine efficiency, query planning and optimization, and performance — setting the direction for how AWS advances the state of the art in open-source analytics.

Draw from your deep and broad technical and management expertise to mentor senior engineers and managers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues, design tradeoffs, and feature and schedule prioritization.

Work with senior executives to develop business targets and resource requirements, influence technical and business strategy, hire talented engineers and managers, and conceive innovative new solutions for customers.

A day in the life

Leading the Open Data Analytics Engines team gives you the opportunity to:

Work on industry-defining products in the rapidly evolving open-source data analytics space

Solve challenging problems in query planning and optimization, distributed query execution, stream processing, resource scheduling, and performance at cloud scale

Build products that deliver the power of open-source analytics with the reliability, security, and ease-of-use customers expect from AWS

Work for a company that is a recognized leader in cloud computing

Be involved in the fast-growing cloud analytics and data lake market

Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for the future of open-source analytics on AWS

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) or equivalent work experience

10+ years in the development of mission-critical system software, including work on distributed systems, large-scale data processing, or analytics platforms

5+ years managing engineering teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing and deploying cloud-based analytics technology, particularly services built on open-source frameworks (Spark, Presto/Trino, Flink, Hive)

Deep knowledge of query planning and optimization, whether gained through distributed query engines or relational databases along with resource scheduling, data lake architectures, and performance tuning at petabyte scale

Experience operating services at global scale with stringent latency, throughput, and availability requirements

Advanced degree: Masters or PhD in Computer Science or Engineering, or MBA or similar business qualification

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response. Data Center capacity planning and reporting
May assist in the design and build out of new facilities
Work with IT managers and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability and efficiency

Responsible for asset and inventory management
Respond to out of hours emergency calls – second level escalation point for Data Center acilities related issues / failures

We are looking for a Director of Data to own our data strategy and platform as we scale toward software-defined vehicles.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll set technical direction and stay close to the architecture and code, while building and managing a high-performing team responsible for high-volume, high-velocity vehicle and enterprise data.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Controls Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a leader for the Controls Engineering function. As the single-threaded owner of controls and automation strategy, your organization will own the full lifecycle—design, programming, commissioning, deployment, ramp, and sustained operations. You will define controls standards, architect the integration strategy across MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA layers, and partner with integrators to ensure flawless execution.

This role spans pilot operations through high-volume production across diverse processes. You will build a multi-disciplinary team of controls, automation, and SCADA engineers who support line development, launch, and sustained production. You will operate with high autonomy and a bias for action—diving deep into systems architecture and team development while ensuring daily production reliability, safety, and performance.

Key job responsibilities

Controls Design & Development

Define and implement global PLC architecture, programming standards, and controls design specifications. Establish a scalable framework supporting pilot through high-volume production.
Develop and enforce controls standards (hardware, software, networking); ensure system integrators and vendors deliver in strict compliance.
Own the SCADA/HMI layer strategy (e.g., Ignition)—design, deploy, and maintain systems providing real-time visibility into line performance, alarms, and production data.
Lead automation integration (e.g., Fanuc, Kuka) across assembly and automation cells, ensuring standardized programming, safety compliance, and maintainability.
Own functional safety design (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and enforce equipment safety standards for all automated systems, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and Amazon safety requirements.

MES & Systems Integration

Architect the MES integration strategy bridging MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA layers. Ensure seamless data flow from shop floor to enterprise systems.
Partner with the Factory Software team on system architecture, data models, and integration. Define clear interface boundaries and ensure coordinated deployment.
Drive traceability, genealogy, and quality data capture at the controls layer to support analytics, yield improvement, and regulatory compliance.
Establish standards for connectivity protocols (OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET), data historians, and reporting infrastructure enabling data-driven decision making.

Line Deployment, Commissioning & Ramp

Own controls engineering scope for line deployment: design review, vendor management, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and ramp to high-volume production.
Manage system integrator relationships end-to-end: define specifications, conduct design reviews, enforce adherence to controls standards, and drive issue resolution.
Lead troubleshooting, optimization, cycle time improvement, and reliability growth through production ramp to steady-state operations.
Collaborate with Operations, Process Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure controls solutions meet their operational and production requirements.
Drive root cause analysis on system failures; implement countermeasures and preventive mechanisms to improve reliability and uptime.
Develop commissioning playbooks, validation protocols, and startup checklists enabling repeatable, rapid line launches across facilities.

Team Building & Sustained Operations

Build the Controls Engineering organization from the ground up: hire and develop a multi-disciplinary team of controls, automation, SCADA, and MES engineers plus technicians.
Establish team structure and operating model supporting line development, launch, and sustained operations with 24/7 production support capability.
Create mechanisms for knowledge management, troubleshooting databases, and continuous improvement of controls reliability (MTTR/MTBF).
Own technical documentation for all electrical and control systems.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and operational rigor with the highest standards for system quality and documentation.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, automation engineering, or equivalent, or 1+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
10+ years of experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, or related disciplines.
5+ years in a leadership role building and managing multi-disciplinary controls/automation engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience deploying control systems from pilot through volume production, including FAT, SAT, commissioning, and ramp.
Hands-on experience in production environments with exposure to operations and the practical challenges of sustaining automated systems.
Expertise in PLC programming and architecture (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000/ControlLogix).
Experience with SCADA/HMI system design, deployment, and management (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, WinCC).
Experience managing system integrators and ensuring vendor compliance with controls standards. Working knowledge of MES architecture and integration with ERP, WMS, QMS, and shop-floor systems.
Experience in high-mix or evolving product environments where controls systems must adapt to frequent design changes.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Enterprise Foundations is the engineering team responsible for the architectural and integration work that allows Instacart's Retailer Platform to scale across the world's largest grocers. Our work spans omnichannel integrations — bringing products like FoodStorm catering and Caper Carts onto unified Instacart platform rails — enterprise extensibility (sandbox environments, configuration systems, retailer-facing tooling), and the cross-cutting data isolation work that allows Instacart's ML and Data Engineering teams to safely build per-retailer models on top of the platform. As Instacart's enterprise retail business expands to hundreds of partner brands and new international markets, this team's work is foundational to how the platform matures.

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to lead this team of ~12 engineers. You'll set the unifying technical thesis for the team — multi-tenancy, data isolation, configuration-driven release management, and per-retailer extensibility — and drive the consolidation work that replaces bespoke per-vertical services with shared platform rails. In close partnership with Connected Stores, Pro Services, Commerce, Data Engineering, and ML, you'll broker the architectural and prioritization trade-offs that determine how Instacart serves enterprise retailers across multiple commerce surfaces.

About The Job

Lead, coach, and grow a senior-skewed team of ~12 engineers across multiple workstreams; set clear architectural and execution direction, develop talent, and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Set and maintain the unifying technical thesis for the team — multi-tenancy, data isolation, configuration-driven release management, and per-retailer extensibility — ensuring related workstreams converge on shared solutions rather than parallel implementations.
Drive consolidation of bespoke retailer-vertical services — catering order management, smart-cart backend logic, kiosk integrations, in-store mobile — onto unified Instacart platform rails, so each surface inherits Instacart's ranking, search, recommendations, and fulfillment.
Partner with ML and Data Engineering on long-term enterprise data platform compliance for our ML systems, ensuring per-retailer model training has the data, signals, and isolation it needs.
Deliver self-service tooling — including sandbox environments, configuration interfaces, and retailer-facing extensibility — that lets retailers and internal teams ship without engineering bottlenecks.
Represent technical and product trade-offs across multiple engineering and product organizations whose roadmaps and integration commitments evolve in real time; broker resourcing decisions, drive clarity in ambiguous scope, and ensure engineering investment stays aligned with committed work.

8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineering teams delivering platform or infrastructure products in a B2B or enterprise context.
Experience leading teams of 10+ engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development of senior individual contributors.
Demonstrated success operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments where partner roadmaps, product coverage, and integration commitments are still maturing — with a track record of driving clarity and forward motion through that ambiguity.
Proven cross-functional leadership influencing outcomes across multiple engineering and product organizations, including comfort using structured escalation to unblock multi-team initiatives.
Experience leading multi-team architectural transitions such as consolidation, replatforming, multi-tenancy, or data isolation inside an established business with real customers and revenue.
Technical proficiency in distributed systems, API/SDK design, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS or GCP).
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Direct domain experience in commerce platforms, omnichannel retail, OMS, POS, catering systems, or connected-store / in-store technology.
Track record of building multi-tenant platforms serving multiple internal or external customers, with per-tenant configuration, isolation, and extensibility requirements.

Background scaling enterprise integrations and managing partner-facing technical relationships across product, engineering, and customer-facing functions.

If you've been waiting for a role where you can combine the strategic scope of senior leadership with the hands-on intensity of a startup founder — this is it.

Key job responsibilities

Build and lead a world-class engineering organization. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent. Stand up multiple development teams from the ground up, establishing the structures, rituals, and expectations that define how a high-performing org operates — without the bureaucracy.
Set technical vision and product strategy: Partner with security researchers, applied scientists, product managers, and UX designers to translate customer problems into bold technical bets. Drive execution with startup urgency: Manage multiple concurrent initiatives across teams while maintaining the speed and focus of a small, scrappy operation. Decompose ambiguous, high-stakes problems into actionable plans. Remove blockers ruthlessly. Ship fast, learn from what you ship, and iterate.
Define and advance AI/ML capabilities: Lead strategic decisions on agentic systems, RAG architectures, conversational interfaces, and intelligent automation pipelines. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and make high-judgment build vs. buy decisions that keep the team on the forefront of AI.
Own operational excellence and security posture: Establish industry-leading reliability, performance, and security practices across your services. Build scalable, reusable mechanisms that simplify operations and accelerate delivery. Ensure your teams operate with the rigor of Amazon and the agility of a startup.
Influence beyond your org: Drive cross-organizational initiatives, build consensus with senior stakeholders, and write compelling vision documents and strategic narratives. Proactively identify technology gaps and opportunities that extend beyond your immediate scope.

Description

Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) provides industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance for object storage. Through the use of pioneering techniques in large-scale distributed computing, developers can durably store their data on AWS's proven computing infrastructure to achieve virtually limitless storage capacity at minimal cost. Amazon S3 provides simple APIs that can be used to store and retrieve any amount of data at any time. Customers of all sizes, from day one startups to the world's largest enterprises, use Amazon S3 to deliver next-generation applications that range from data analytics to AI to photo and video archives. While S3 has seen tremendous growth since launch in 2006, we are still in the early stages of realizing its full potential.

As a Sr. Manager, Software Development for S3 Request Processing, you will be responsible for leading a group of top talent that builds the software handling every S3 request at massive scale. Your organization owns the request processing platform, the business logic that implements S3's API surface, and the security controls that keep customer data safe. We build innovative software solutions to provide S3 customers secure, durable, available, and performant request handling with virtually infinite scale and extremely low cost. In this role you will drive the roadmap, deliver new functionality and architectures, and raise the bar for operational excellence. You'll lead multiple engineering teams to spearhead new technologies that change what is possible within S3. You'll also own the financial health of your services and engage directly with senior customers to represent the S3 business.

Success in this role requires a leader experienced in establishing and building relationships with a wide range of peers, including senior AWS leaders, customers at all levels of experience and responsibility, deeply technical software and systems engineers within the team, and partner organizations across S3 and AWS. This leader must have the proven skills to easily switch between weighing in on complex engineering details of a high-throughput, low-latency request path, taking a long-term view of the business, growing and developing the next generation of AWS engineering and management talent, and operating as a large-organization leader. It requires an ability to prioritize work for the direct team and partner teams, establish goals, and focus attention on the most important inputs to drive the desired business outcomes. This leader must be capable of scaling themselves and their team to meet the ever-increasing demands of a fast-growing business. You'll need to excel at hiring and developing your technical talent. Come work hard and make history with Amazon S3!

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon S3 Tables is the first cloud object store with built-in Apache Iceberg support, purpose-built for storing and querying tabular data at massive scale. It is fully managed, continuously optimizing, and delivers up-to 10x higher transactions per second than Iceberg tables on general purpose S3 buckets, all within the same foundation that gives S3 eleven nines of durability. Customers are bringing their most demanding analytics workloads to S3 Tables, from streaming ingestion of IoT and application telemetry to multi-petabyte lakehouses powering multiple AWS and partner query engines, and a growing wave of AI agents that query data directly through the Model Context Protocol. Our mission is simple and ambitious which is to make S3 Tables the best place on Earth to store and query Iceberg data, and reinvent what an analytics-native object store can be.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the multi-team S3 Tables organization. In this role, you will own the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution for the service, working at a scale that very few engineers in the industry ever encounter. Your organization will ship innovations that customers feel directly in query latency, cost per terabyte scanned, ingestion throughput, and the simplicity of running an open lakehouse on AWS.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, open-source table formats, and large-scale analytics. You will help define how Iceberg evolves in the cloud, partnering with the Apache Iceberg community and with engine teams across AWS and partners to make sure S3 Tables is the gravitational center of the open analytics ecosystem. Internally, you will partner with S3 storage, indexing, and control plane teams, and with AWS analytics leadership, to deliver a service that is both deeply integrated and uncompromisingly open.

We want a leader who thinks big, invents on behalf of customers, and is energized by problems that only show up at S3 scale. The bar is high and the opportunity to shape how the world stores and analyzes its data is higher.

S3 Tables is a new, fast moving team building within the most durable and scalable storage system ever built. We are early in our journey, the product is young, the customer base is growing quickly, and the surface area in front of us is large. We are doing this in the open with Apache Iceberg, obsessing over customer workloads, and inventing in places others assume are solved. If you want to help build something into what it can become, rather than maintain what already is, this is the team.

Lead and grow a multi-team organization of senior engineers and engineering managers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, deep ownership, and customer obsession.

Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
, we build the future of the cloud for Enterprises as a diverse team of fellow creators and inventors. We act with the speed and attitude of a start-up, with the scale and customer-focus of the leading enterprise software company in the world.

Values are OCI’s foundation and how we deliver excellence. We strive for equity, inclusion, and respect for all. We are committed to the greater good in our products and our actions.

We are constantly learning and taking opportunities to grow our careers and ourselves. We challenge each other to stretch beyond our past to build our future.

You are the builder here. You will be part of a team of really smart, motivated, and diverse people and given the autonomy and support to do your best work. It is a dynamic and flexible workplace where you’ll belong and be encouraged.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a manager with distributed systems experience - building cost efficient and scalable systems from scratch. You have led a team covering at least a single service or multiple micro-services within a larger service. You were fully responsible for design, delivery, and operations of all components in this space. You are an expert manager and owned roadmap planning, talent review, and goal setting for your team. You have been responsible for building your team including recruiting, hiring, and performance management.

You’ve operated high-scale services and understand how to make them more resilient. You have experience working with services that require data to travel long distances, but have to abide by compliance and regulations. You stay up at night thinking about how to protect the service from upstream dependencies. You will be technically strong and get a lot done – you’ve worked on services that are highly available, scalable, and redundant. You understand that simple systems are easier to operate and troubleshoot. You can balance speed and quality with iteration and incremental improvements. You’ve made life easier for your developers and have motivated your teams to make both process and service improvements with your ability to automate and instrument properly to get the right data. You understand operational perfection and how to instill a culture of being proactive with your teammates. The person in this role will get a lot done on a daily basis, grow and develop the team and roadmap, drive execution of features and projects, and own feature design.

What are the biggest challenges for the team?

The biggest product challenges for the team are scalability, performance, availability, operations. The growth of the business is driving us to improve the ability of our systems to scale out and handle traffic patterns that are several orders of magnitude greater than what we can support today. We understand that software is living and needs investment. The challenge is making the right trade-offs, communicating those decisions effectively, and crisp execution. We need managers who can lead their team to build services that handle millions of requests per second. We seek managers who can determine how we can survive regional data center outages and protect our customers. We need managers who can enable their team to build services that enable us to offer even more options to customers and contribute to the overall growth of Oracle

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

The platforms in our Engineering Acceleration org dictate how thousands of Roblox engineers ship, and how every backend service gets built, deployed, and kept reliable at scale. They sit on the critical path for production reliability, developer velocity, and security posture. Reporting to Andrew Swerdlow, you will rethink the entire engineering toolchain from the ground up to be agentic-native, creating a world where AI agents are first-class participants in software development and humans set direction and supervise. This is a unique opportunity to define what modern engineering infrastructure looks like at one of the largest platforms in the world.

You Will

Reimagine the engineering toolchain as agentic-native, designing the platforms, guardrails, and feedback loops that let AI agents safely drive migrations, validation, and routine operational work.

Make software quality and SEV prevention a measurable property of the platform by investing in safe-change mechanisms, automated verification, progressive rollout, and fast, reliable rollback.
Drive down operational toil through automation, transforming manual, repeat work like patching and large-scale migrations into self-serve or agent-driven workflows.
Own and drive the roadmap, aligning cross-pod plans and execution against company goals for safe rollouts.

You Have

Experience leading and growing engineering teams (including managing managers and/or senior ICs), with a strong people-development track record.
Strong technical depth in backend/distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, enabling you to engage credibly on system design and technical decisions.

new_jobs.title: Director, Embedded Software Engineering, Amazon Leo
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Director of Embedded Software Engineering will lead mission-critical embedded software development for Amazon Leo's satellite bus systems, ensuring our satellite constellation meets aggressive reliability, security, and performance targets from manufacturing through end-of-life operations.

This role owns all embedded software development and systems testing for satellite spacecraft systems — including flight software, real-time operating systems, avionics, and on-orbit software validation. You will architect the software that sits on the satellite, manage the end-to-end software stack to bring up the satellite, and lead comprehensive system testing to ensure spacecraft readiness for launch and on-orbit operations.

This is a highly technical leadership role requiring hands-on embedded software architecture expertise combined with the ability to build and scale high-performing engineering organizations. You will work in constrained hardware environments where computing resources (processing power, memory, power consumption) are severely limited. A satellite has 600+ unique processors — it's like having its own compact data center in space — requiring sophisticated embedded software solutions to coordinate this complexity.

Key job responsibilities

As a group leader, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. The ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.

Embedded Software Architecture & Development

Define and implement end-to-end embedded software architecture for satellite bus systems
Lead development of real-time operating system (RTOS) implementations for spacecraft control, including scheduling algorithms and embedded design patterns
Architect Linux OS solutions for satellite systems
Drive hardware bring-up processes: boot, hardware verification, and comprehensive testing
Design and implement control systems, redundancy management, and health check software
Develop and oversee software for custom ASICs and FPGAs used in spacecraft systems
Architect solutions for complex application synchronization (e.g., global time clock syncing)
Address avionics systems challenges unique to spacecraft operations

Satellite Bus Software & Systems Testing

Lead software development for satellite bus systems, including:
Flight software and spacecraft control
Attitude determination and control systems (ADCS)
Power management and distribution
Thermal control systems
Command and data handling
Fault detection, isolation, and recovery (FDIR)
Onboard autonomy and health monitoring
Own systems test strategy and execution for satellite systems, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation frameworks
Lead on-orbit software testing and validation for operational satellites
Establish multi-test environments and continuous test/deployment pipelines
Drive software quality from prototype satellites to production at scale

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

Provide close partnership with Hardware Engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle — from component design through integration and launch
Create documentation for worldwide regulatory bodies
Work closely with research teams to evaluate and simulate system-level performance
Provide technical leadership while meeting aggressive project schedules
Drive operational excellence and optimize system performance (e.g., battery usage, resource management)

Team Building & Organizational Leadership

Scale the embedded software engineering organization from current state to production needs
Hire and develop exceptional embedded software engineers and leaders
Manage multiple engineering teams as a leader of leaders (100+ people)
Foster a culture of innovation, speed, and technical excellence consistent with a "new space" mindset
Develop talent pipeline for specialized embedded systems expertise

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related STEM discipline
US Citizenship, Permanent Resident (Green Card), or Political Asylum status required
Min 10+ years of experience as a manager of managers leading multiple engineering teams
Proven track record building and scaling engineering organizations (70+ people)
Demonstrated ability to grow teams from scratch and scale to production operations
Experience managing directors, principal engineers, and senior technical leaders

Technical Experience

Min 10+ years of embedded software design and development for mission-critical systems
Hands-on experience with embedded software architecture and implementation — must be comfortable conducting architectural reviews and discussing technical implementations directly with engineers
Strong Unix/Linux and systems development skills
Proven experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS) architecture and implementation
Deep understanding of embedded software design patterns and best practices
Experience with hardware-software integration in constrained environments
Track record taking projects from scoping requirements to successful launch

Software Development Methodology

"Build quickly" mindset — test on the ground and anticipate how it will work in space
Proven ability to balance speed with reliability in aerospace-grade environments
Experience with rapid iteration and continuous test/deployment pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

Aerospace & Satellite Systems Experience

Hands-on experience with aerospace and avionics systems and techniques for high reliability/robust design
Experience leading satellite bus software development — flight software, attitude control, power management, spacecraft systems
On-orbit software testing and validation experience for operational satellites ("testing SW on satellites")
Experience with space-qualified software development and certification processes
Understanding of radiation-tolerant computing and fault-tolerant system design
Familiarity with spacecraft subsystem integration and testing
Experience working on subsystems and subcomponents (not just system integration)
Experience with laser/optical inter-satellite link (OISL) software development is a strong differentiator

Embedded Systems Expertise

Experience developing software for custom ASICs and FPGAs
Deep knowledge of scheduling algorithms for real-time systems
Expertise in embedded control systems design and implementation
Experience with safety-critical software development standards
Knowledge of hardware acceleration techniques for embedded systems
Familiarity with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulation frameworks for spacecraft validation

Technical Tools & Platforms

Proficiency with C/C++, ADA (primary languages for flight software)
Experience with Python, Matlab for simulation and analysis
Familiarity with DOORS, JAMA or similar requirements management tools
Experience with AWS cloud environments for ground systems integration
Knowledge of version control, CI/CD, and automated testing frameworks

Industry Experience

Substantial space industry experience (5+ years preferred)
10+ years managing products, budgets, and justifying resource needs to senior leaders
Background in fast-paced "new space" environments strongly preferred over traditional aerospace
10+ years managing products, budgets, and justifying resource needs to senior leaders and finance partners

Description

Come build the future of data streaming with the Amazon Managed Streaming for Kafka (MSK) team!

We are seeking builders for our Amazon MSK service, a fully managed service that makes it easy for customers to build and run applications that use Apache Kafka to process streaming data. We are looking for managers and engineers who are enthusiastic about data streaming, and are as passionate about contributing to open source as they are about solving real customers' business needs, at AWS scale.

As a member of the Amazon MSK team, you will be making contributions to the entire stack - the APIs and the workflows that make up the MSK service, the core Kafka platform, and stand-alone tools that make it easier for Kafka community to operate Kafka better. Upstream compatibility is a core tenet of MSK. Your code changes to the Kafka platform will be released back to open source. As a member of a new AWS service that builds on top of a popular open source technology, this is a unique opportunity to work on a team that straddles both worlds – open source and Amazon-internal software. You will design and build new features, make performance improvements, identify and investigate new technologies, prototype solutions, build scalable services, and test and review changes, to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in meaningful work that will improve healthcare outcomes for customers.

Own the security architecture for products that will enforce and enable secure development of Amazon’s healthcare services and continue to protect customer data.
Partner with engineering leaders in Amazon Health Services to reduce the friction for builders to develop services that are secure by design.
Work closely with your customers, partner teams, and foundational engineering teams to ensure the needs of your customers are clearly understood and effectively addressed.
Drive adoption and integration of Amazon's paved path security solutions across subsidiaries.
Recruit, coach, develop, and scale a team of world class security engineers, providing strategic and tactical oversight to maintain a motivated, innovative, and effective team.

A day in the life

This position within the Healthcare Security team represents a rare opportunity to get in with a fast-growing business. You will lead teams to design secure architecture and build layers of security controls to protect customer information and our infrastructure.

A successful candidate will bring deep technical security and software expertise, strong business acumen, and judgment. You will define the right long-term security architecture partnering with our engineering leaders, and deliver innovative ideas to improve security across both internal and third-party services that we use to deliver the customer experience. new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Access Management Services (AMS) organization builds and operates the authorization backbone for all of Amazon. Our services govern who and what can access resources across the company — from group membership and ownership to policy evaluation and contingent authorization, to access lifecycle management. We secure authorization decisions at Amazon scale. Security is our top priority, but we also obsess over availability, latency, and cost-to-serve for the teams that depend on us.

AMS is looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Manager to lead the organization that builds, owns, and operates Amazon's attribute-based access control (ABAC) policy services. Your team defines how authorization policies are expressed, evaluated, and enforced across Amazon — making access decisions for every service and workflow that touches protected resources. You will own Tier-1 services foundational to Amazon's operations while driving a shift from manual, team-by-team policy configuration toward intelligent defaults and automated guardrails that reduce friction for builders without compromising the security bar. This is a hard problem — ABAC policy must be expressive enough to cover wildly diverse authorization use cases, reliable enough to bear deep operational dependencies, and performant enough to operate at a scale where even small design choices have outsized blast radius.

This team is in the middle of a fundamental acceleration. The rise of agentic AI across Amazon is reshaping how authorization works — and how we build it. We're applying generative AI to compress our own development cycles, transform how we operate Tier-1 services, and deliver new AI-native authorization capabilities that let Amazon's businesses safely adopt agentic workloads at speed. If you love transforming legacy processes, building high-performing teams, and operating at a pace that matches the moment, this role will fit. You'll have substantial visibility with senior executives and the mandate to move fast. You'll need strong instincts for security outcomes paired with a passion for customer experience — and the technical depth to guide and riase the bar on principal engineers, SDEs, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence.

This role invents and delivers for internal customers and is inherently cross-functional and requires the ability to think big and collaborate with others as you work closely with teams across engineering, operations, finance, and security. We are looking for a critical thinker who thrives on solving challenges in partnership with teams across Amazon.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Manager - AI Memory Systems, Customer 360
new_jobs.description:
Description

Every time a customer tells Alexa about a dietary preference, buys running shoes, streams a sci-fi movie, or adds dog food to their cart, that moment should shape every future interaction across Amazon. Your job is to make that happen.

We're hiring a Senior Manager to lead the teams that build Amazon's AI memory — the system that understands who each customer is, what they care about, who's in their family (pets included), and what they need next. Your work powers every major AI experience at Amazon: Alexa+, Alexa for Shopping, Search, Homepage, Prime Video, Music, Audible, Health AI, and more. This is a critical company-wide initiative touching every business at Amazon.

What Makes This Role Different

You own the full pipeline from raw signal to real-time AI retrieval — not just one piece of the stack
Your science teams generate inferences across all of Amazon's businesses, not a single vertical
You partner with 10+ organizations and influence without authority at the most senior levels
You build for conversational AI agents that need to recall the right memory in the right moment at real-time speed

The systems you own are already at massive scale and growing fast — this isn't a roadmap on a whiteboard

If you want to shape how AI understands and remembers hundreds of millions of customers, and you thrive leading science and engineering teams through ambiguity at scale, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow multiple science and engineering teams that generate, store, and serve customer inferences across all Amazon businesses — building the AI-ready representations that power personalized experiences for hundreds of millions of customers.

Own the customer inference pipeline end-to-end: from raw signals (purchases, browsing, streaming, listening, reading, conversations) through inference generation to real-time retrieval by AI agents and recommendation systems.

Define and execute the technical strategy for family and household understanding — identifying the important people, pets, and vehicles in each customer's life and enabling personalized recommendations for each.

Drive memory quality at scale: establish precision and recall targets, build evaluation frameworks, and continuously improve the accuracy of both explicit memories (what customers tell us) and inferred memories (what we learn from their behavior).

Serve as the primary technical voice for customer understanding in executive reviews, translating complex inference systems into clear narratives about customer impact and business value.

Partner with 10+ organizations (Alexa, Alexa for Shopping, Search, Prime Video, Music, Audible, Books, Ads, Grocery, Health AI, Amazon Business) to ensure customer memories are adopted and delivering value across every major Amazon surface.

Build and operate contextual retrieval systems that serve the right customer memories to the right AI agent at the right moment, under strict latency requirements.

Define privacy-by-design principles for customer memory: ensure every inference respects consent, deletion promises, regulatory requirements, and customer trust while maximizing personalization value.

Establish cross-business data governance standards — authoring schemas, onboarding processes, and quality gates that allow dozens of businesses to contribute customer signals into a unified system without compromising data integrity.

Hire, develop, and retain world-class applied scientists and engineers, fostering a culture of scientific rigor, rapid experimentation, and customer obsession.

About The Team

Customer 360 is Amazon's central memory system. Our mission: when a customer interacts with any part of Amazon, every other part reflects that understanding immediately. We process signals from across Amazon — shopping, streaming, listening, reading, browsing, and conversations — and transform them into AI-ready memories that power personalized experiences for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. Our memories fuel Amazon's largest AI initiatives including Alexa+, Alexa for Shopping, Health AI, conversational assistants, generative recommendation systems, and personalized discovery across every major surface. We operate at massive scale. We are a team of builders who believe that understanding customers deeply — and remembering what matters to them — is the foundation of every great AI experience.

Capacity Ingestion and Management:

Implements expectations for identifying opportunities for prototyping and manages prototyping initiatives (e.g., testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Development Manager, Specialist Technology Team
new_jobs.description:
Description

Every AWS workshop, GameDay, or any other kind of hands-on event a customer touches starts as content that someone has to create, ensure it is safe and high-quality, and then find a way deliver at scale. This role owns that entire lifecycle. Workshop Studio is the service the AWS Tech Field uses to give customers hands-on experience with AWS, powering ~97% of hands-on sessions at re:Invent and the global Summit series. In 2025 alone, the Field ran nearly 50,000 events globally, reaching over 710,000 participants. Behind the platform sits one of the largest fleets of AWS accounts on the planet, along with a Gen AI content scanner handling over a million quality and security scans a month before content ever reaches a customer.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to own content quality and delivery end-to-end. This is a manager-of-managers role leading several distinct teams, each with its own area of focus: the engineering teams behind Workshop Studio, spanning content authoring and publishing, event creation and delivery, and the underlying AWS account fleet operations; the team that builds the Gen AI content scanner that evaluates content for quality and security, scaling review processes without adding human reviewers; and a content quality program that ties these together, defining what the quality bar is, partnering with business leaders across their domains to identify top-performing content, and setting the strategy for how that content is scaled and through which channels. Together they own how technical content is created, how its quality and security bar is enforced, and how it is delivered to customers, including self-service, hands-on experiences in Amazon Builder Center, AWS's primary customer-facing community engagement platform. Because you own the full lifecycle rather than a single piece of it, you have the autonomy and agency to define the North Star and charter for this business and build a cohesive strategy across all of your teams.

Our ideal candidate is passionate about owning large-scale, always-on services and building leaders. You are equally comfortable setting a multi-year vision and diving into the operational reality of a service thousands of Solutions Architects and AWS customers depend on daily. Gen AI runs throughout this space, and there are several areas of active investment. Human review alone cannot keep pace with the volume of content moving through these systems, so Gen AI does the heavy lifting of evaluating quality and in the fullness of time, security, at scale. We are automating event support to shorten response times and put resolution directly in the hands of event operators. We are also investing in content generation to make high-quality content easier to produce, which in turn streamlines the review it has to pass. For a leader looking to deepen their team's AI impact on a critical, high-visibility service, there is significant room to invest and grow.

Lead a multi-team organization: Lead multiple engineering and program teams, coaching managers, setting engineering standards, and driving delivery against organizational goals.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Ever wondered what it takes to build Amazon's massive global network — and how we make sure every dollar spent on construction delivers maximum value?

We're looking for a Senior Value Engineering Manager who will own cost engineering and value engineering on large-scale construction projects and help shape the future of AI-powered cost intelligence. This isn't a back-office analytics role — you'll be influencing multi-million-dollar supplier negotiations, presenting to senior leadership, and support building the tools that will transform how Amazon Global Procurement Organization models, negotiates and manages construction cost worldwide.

Construction is one of our largest and most complex procurement categories. Every project is different — unique site conditions, local labor markets, permit requirements, and material constraints mean that each costing cycle demands a fresh bottom-up deep dive: decomposing cost structures, stress-testing assumptions against local market realities, and building analytics that reflect the true cost drivers of that specific build. You'll bring deep construction industry expertise and pair it with a forward-looking mindset, co-creating AI-driven tools that scale your impact far beyond individual projects.

Key job responsibilities

Deliver independent, bottom-up construction cost estimates for North America Design & Construction stakeholders across retrofit, expansion, and new-build projects spanning multiple building types and fulfillment network segments.

Develop cost estimates from early-stage concepts through RFP-ready construction documents, selecting appropriate methodologies and analytical depth based on project maturity and available information.

Own estimating strategies for repeatable multi-site programs by developing scalable templates while producing detailed bottom-up estimates for complex, site-specific projects requiring advanced analytical judgment.

Generate conceptual ROM estimates to support early project planning, business case development, investment decisions, and funding approvals.

Lead should-cost modeling, benchmarking, and Value Engineering analyses to identify cost optimization opportunities while preserving design intent, quality, constructability, schedule, and operational requirements.

Leverage AI-powered tools to improve estimating efficiency through automated data gathering, benchmarking, and cost analysis while applying engineering judgment to validate outputs and resolve complex or ambiguous scopes.

Drive development of scalable AI-enabled estimating solutions by curating project and market cost data, validating model performance, and identifying opportunities to automate routine estimating activities.

Partner with preconstruction managers, design engineers, sourcing teams, category managers, and business stakeholders to validate assumptions, communicate cost risks, evaluate alternatives, and influence cost-informed decisions throughout project development.

Establish estimating best practices through peer reviews, continuous improvement initiatives, and maintenance of current labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and market pricing databases to ensure consistent, accurate, and defensible cost models.

About The Team

The Sourcing Excellence team helps Amazon answer two fundamental questions: **Are we buying the right product?** (Value Engineering) and **Are we paying the right price?** (Cost Engineering). **Value Engineering** ensures Amazon is investing in the right solutions by optimizing specifications, design, materials, and performance to maximize business value while meeting operational requirements. **Cost Engineering** establishes cost transparency and price confidence through bottom-up cost estimation, should-cost modeling, benchmarking, market intelligence, and cost driver analysis to determine what products and services should cost.

Together, these disciplines provide transparent, fact-based insights that enable informed sourcing, design, and investment decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Our vision is to make cost and value transparency a strategic capability across the organization, ensuring every investment delivers the optimal balance of cost, quality, performance, and operational requirements. Today, the team supports billions of dollars in managed spend across multiple global categories and continues to scale its impact through AI-enabled solutions, standardized mechanisms, and cross-functional partnerships.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field
Experience as an Architect, Engineer, Construction Manager, Development Manager, Owner's project management representative or in other Commercial Development and Construction related disciplines
Experience developing bottom-up cost models, should-cost models, cost benchmarks, cost driver analysis, and analytical frameworks to support complex construction or capital investment decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience operating within at least two disciplines within the construction industry, such as Contracting, Owners Representation, Architecture, Design and Engineering, Commercial Development, analysis and control of construction costs or similar
Experience in project management in construction and contracts management
AI&Automation: Comfortable working with AI and automation as a default part of your workflow — not as an experiment, but as how things get done. You should be willing to use AI-powered tools for cost benchmarking, estimating, modelling and pattern recognition, curate project data to feed scalable models, validate automated outputs with expert judgment, and identify where automation can absorb routine work so you can focus on the complex and ambiguous. Experience contributing to AI tool development in an estimating or procurement context is a strong differentiator.
Data Management & Cost Estimation Software
Experience managing structured cost data and supporting back-end estimation workflows — organizing inputs, maintaining cost libraries, and ensuring data integrity across project portfolios. Proficiency with CostX or equivalent takeoff and cost modeling software is strongly preferred. Familiarity with Amazon's internal estimating systems and tools is a plus but not required; what matters most is a demonstrated ability to pick up new platforms quickly and maintain discipline in data management practices.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, 5G RAN – Core Systems Software Architecture
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver high-speed, low-latency broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the design, development, and lab integration of real-time communications software enabling robust, standards-compliant connectivity between gNodeB platforms and Multi-Operator Core Network (MOCN) environments.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP control-plane and data-plane protocols, extensive experience with NGC and NGU interfaces, and the ability to architect, partition, and guide the implementation of complex software systems. Equally important, this leader will build, develop, and mentor a high-performing engineering team, fostering a culture of technical excellence, continuous learning, and career growth.

The ideal candidate brings 10+ years experience developing interfaces to 5G Core networks, a strong understanding of RRC signaling, Multi-PLMN broadcast configuration, and PLMN operations, as well as practical expertise with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and physical integration of RAN and transport systems in a lab environment. This Senior Manager will play a critical leadership role in hiring, mentoring, and developing engineers across multiple levels while driving execution of complex technical programs.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Architect and design the full software stack enabling real-time control-plane and data-plane communication between gNodeB and MOCN environments in support of Amazon Leo's satellite-terrestrial integration objectives.
Define software partitioning, module boundaries, and interface specifications for NGC, NGU, RRC, and Multi-PLMN broadcast components.
Lead development of 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity.
Oversee integration of transport technologies, including MPLS and segment routing, into the RAN–Core connectivity architecture.
Drive troubleshooting and performance optimization across NGC, NGU, and RRC layers.
Author technical specifications, architecture documents, and interface control documents (ICDs) for internal and external stakeholders.
Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving MOCN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned with Amazon Leo's roadmap.

Lab Integration & Hardware-in-the-Loop Testing

Lead lab activities including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test framework development, physical interface validation, and system-level integration testing.
Develop and validate HIL test frameworks ensuring accurate modeling of physical interfaces, fronthaul/backhaul connectivity, and multi-operator core interactions.
Oversee lab infrastructure planning, equipment procurement, and test environment configuration to support rapid prototyping and validation cycles.
Drive lab-based integration of RAN, transport, and core network components, ensuring end-to-end system alignment and standards compliance.
Collaborate with RF, RAN, and Core engineering teams in the lab to validate satellite-terrestrial network interoperability.

Team Building & People Development

Build and scale a high-performing software engineering team through strategic hiring, including conducting phone screens, on-site interviews, and bar raiser activities.
Develop individual growth plans for each engineer, identifying technical and leadership development opportunities aligned with career aspirations.
Mentor engineers at all levels, providing regular coaching on technical depth, system design thinking, and Amazon's Leadership Principles.
Foster a culture of continuous learning through technical brown bags, design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Identify and develop future technical leaders within the team, creating pathways for promotion and increased scope.
Conduct regular 1:1s focused on career development, skill gap analysis, and stretch assignments that accelerate engineer growth.
Create an inclusive team environment that encourages innovation, calculated risk-taking, and learning from failure.
Drive organizational health metrics including retention, engagement, and internal mobility.

Program Execution & Amazon Leadership

Own the technical roadmap and execution plan, driving delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
Operate with a bias for action while maintaining the highest bar for quality and safety in satellite communications systems.
Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, design documents) to senior leadership.
Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
Demonstrate Ownership by treating the team's mission as your own, and Earn Trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of people management, managing engineers experience
10+ years of experience developing software for 4G/5G Core interfaces, RAN–Core integration, or cellular protocol stacks.
Deep expertise in 3GPP NGC (control plane) and NGU (user plane) protocols.
Strong understanding of RRC signaling, RAN procedures, and Multi-PLMN broadcast configuration.
Proven experience architecting real-time communications protocol stacks with deterministic timing requirements.
Experience with gNodeB integration in multi-operator or shared-RAN environments (MOCN, MORAN, etc.).
Strong knowledge of PLMN operations, network slicing concepts, and multi-operator resource sharing.
Expertise with MPLS, segment routing, and transport-network engineering for RAN backhaul.
Demonstrated experience working in lab environments, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing, physical interface modeling, and test automation.
Proven track record of building engineering teams from the ground up, including defining team structure, hiring plans, and development frameworks.
Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, with measurable outcomes in promotions, skill development, and retention.
Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with O-RAN architectures, F1/E1 interfaces, or distributed RAN deployments.
Familiarity with SDN controllers, network orchestration, or cloud-native 5G Core implementations.

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Sr Manager role will lead the development for Amazon Leo's satellite payload systems, ensuring our payload embedded and networking software meets reliability, security, and performance targets from manufacturing through customer operations.

You will architect the software that sits on the satellite, manage the end-to-end embedded and networking stack to bring up the satellite, ground systems, customer terminals , and lead comprehensive system testing to ensure spacecraft readiness for launch and on-orbit operations.

This is a highly technical leadership role requiring hands-on embedded and networking software architecture expertise combined with the ability to build and scale high-performing engineering organizations. You will work in constrained hardware environments where computing resources (processing power, memory, power consumption) are severely limited. A satellite has 600+ unique processors — it's like having its own compact data center in space — requiring sophisticated embedded software solutions to coordinate this complexity.

You will draw from deep and broad technical expertise to guide software engineers, principal engineers, and development managers on system design, incremental delivery, and operational excellence. You will apply AI and machine learning to transform how your systems operate: from computer vision that performs real-time authorization decisions, to automated triage and anomaly detection, to intelligent provisioning that eliminates manual effort. AWS Data Centers run critical IT infrastructure and require a reliable supply of uninterrupted cooling and power at all times in order to deliver continuous uptime availability and service for our customers. We are growing our team in South Africa and are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations technical leader to operate as a Senior Chief Engineer and support the DCEO Cluster Manager as required, to join us in Cape Town.

You will support a team of Facility Managers and Chief Engineers across the region and oversee the best in class operations and maintenance of the mechanical and electrical infrastructure for data centers in AWS Cloud region. Our Data Centre Engineering Operations Managers are highly driven, self-managed individuals who demonstrates initiative mindset, proactively seeks solutions to problems and strives for operational excellency.

Key job responsibilities

Safety: Set and maintain the highest standard for safety and actively promote a world-class safety culture.

People Management

Demonstrate capabilities to lead as manager of managers to a wide group of skilled facility professionals:
Hire, manage, develop and coach a team of DC facility management staff
Effectively collaborate with other department leaders including Engineering, Finance, Safety, HR, Recruiting.
Effectively manage vendors and vendor contracting negotiations

Manage operations in a mission critical environment with high complexity and scale while ensuring not to jeopardize quality. Execute strategic preventative maintenance and corrective break-fix planning on mission-critical infrastructures. Review and approve equipment maintenance and repair processes and procedures as well as the ability to tactfully drive continuous organizational change management.
