Description

Amazon pays millions of vendors, suppliers, and partners across every business line, in every geography we operate. Payables Tech owns platforms that make this work: invoice management, payable processing, vendor experience, process automation, fraud detection, and the data services underneath it all.

Our systems move payment volumes that would rank among the largest national economies by GDP. The job is changing rapidly. AI is transforming finance operations, automating routine transactional work so teams can focus on higher-judgment problems. Our vendors are deploying AI-enabled tools to manage payables, submit disputes, and reconcile accounts. Static payment rules are being replaced by ML-driven risk models. Our engineering teams are organizing for AI-native velocity, with small pods of subject matter experts and engineers orchestrating AI-generated features in tight loops. Our vision requires a leader who will drive these transformations, not ride them.

We are looking for a leader responsible for core Amazon Accounts Payable (AP) platforms., leading a 150-person engineering organization. This leader will be part of FinAuto's senior leadership team and own invoice ingestion and validation, payable computation and disposition, payee data management, risk and fraud detection, and the APIs and agent surfaces that vendors and internal customers use to interact with these systems.

Key job responsibilities

Own the technical strategy and multi-year roadmap for Amazon's AP platforms, feeding directly into FinAuto's 3-year strategy
Lead a distributed engineering organization of 150
Deliver ambitious new capabilities: agentic process automation for defect resolution, touchless document processing, ML-based payment risk scoring, and new modes of vendor interaction and self-service
Drive engineering transformation: pioneer AI-native development practices, organize around small outcome-focused, cross-functional teams, and redefine what great engineering looks like for your organization
Maintain operational excellence for payment-critical systems requiring exacting precision, high availability, and regulatory compliance across dozens of countries
Build partnerships with Finance Operations, Controllership, Product, and business line leaders, as well as peer organizations up and downstream
Independently represent the organization with VP-level stakeholders daily

A day in the life

This role leads simultaneous transformation in what gets built (autonomous payments, agentic automation, agent-to-agent commerce), how it gets built (AI-native engineering, small empowered pods), and who builds it. Daily work involves making bold technical bets on distributed systems, navigating change across hundreds of engineers, and demonstrating what's possible — not mandating. You operate with a startup mindset: reducing complexity, driving standards that accelerate building, and moving faster than customers expect. Requires deep technical depth, organizational vision, and clear written communication.

About The Team

FinAuto is one of Amazon's largest fintech organizations. We work with every part of Amazon to capture, compute, transact, and report financial events. Payables Tech owns the platforms that pay Amazon's vendors, from the world's largest suppliers to individual app developers, accurately and on time, across every business and geography.

We process billions of financial events annually through systems that must be precise, fast, and resilient. We are in the middle of a transformation driven by AI on two fronts: what our platforms do and how we build them.

Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering or related field
12+ years of increasing responsibility leading large engineering teams
Strong knowledge of architecting and operating distributed systems at massive scale
Multidisciplinary experience across software development, product management, program management, and quality automation
Experience with domain solutions involving risks that require exacting precision, high availability, and low latency

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years leading engineering organizations of 150+ people while remaining close to critical technical decisions
5+ years interacting regularly with senior level executives
Experience applying AI/ML to production business processes at scale (production, not pilots)
Experience leading teams through transitions to AI-driven development practices
Background in financial systems, payments, or fintech
Experience building multi-tenant platforms that serve as enabling infrastructure for multiple business lines
Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than authority
Exceptional written communication

As Head of Engineering, you ensure our engineering organisation runs efficiently, predictably, and with high technical quality. new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. This committed group works to maintain the critical physical infrastructure that supports Amazon Web Services. Specifically, this team works to ensure that the data center's MEP operates at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups within the data centers.

As the Data Center Engineering Operation (DCEO) Chief Engineer (CE), you will be responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.

As the DCEO Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.

One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, MV/LV power distribution and switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, CRAHs, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building management systems (BMS).

Key job responsibilities

Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in data centers
Operate independently with limited direct management
Assist in the design and build out of new facilities
Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center region and work OT hours as needed to support site stability
Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians and assisting in recruiting efforts for the same
Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
Utilize internal Change Management Systems to manage building workflows
MV/LV Isolation to facilitate maintenance activities
Provide metric availability reporting on a weekly basis

The successful candidate must be able to demonstrate the following competencies and behaviors:

Ability to solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context.
Aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving.
Ability to maintain SLAs through the implementation of proactive issue detection and immediate response.
Proven experience of reading SLDs and control schematics.
Ability to follow support procedures, system documentation, and issue tracking entries into a trouble ticket system.
Shows good judgment and instincts in decision making.
Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
Ability to demonstrate their ability to take ownership of technical issues brought to them by their customer base
Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience

Physical Requirements

Work at heights and from ladders.
Perform physical tasks
Work in a noisy environment with ear protection

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering, Data Center Infrastructure Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) spans 120 Availability Zones within 38 geographic Regions around the world, with announced plans for 10 more Availability Zones and three more Regions — making AWS the most extensive global cloud infrastructure provider and one of the fastest-growing enterprise technology companies ever. Amazon's AWS Data Centers (DC) are a major component of worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure and are industry-leading examples of mission-critical facilities.

Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost-effective DC facilities. We are responsible for achieving world-class uptime for our customers and developing a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet AWS's growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs.

As an Engineering Manager at AWS, you will have the opportunity to impact changes in our current design and establish design procedures and protocols for future systems. AWS Engineering is responsible for the design of all electrical and mechanical systems within all Amazon DCs worldwide. The team works directly with operations, security teams, field engineering, and construction management to implement designs that are functional, practical, and innovative.

The team is seeking a Senior High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Infrastructure Engineering Manager with demonstrated expertise in the design, analysis, and deployment of high-voltage direct current distribution systems, with specific emphasis on 800VDC bus architectures or comparable voltage classes (e.g., ±400V, 600VDC, 1500VDC) in industrial, utility, transportation, renewable energy, or large-scale power infrastructure applications.

This is a highly specialized, foundational engineering role on a newly formed team chartered to design and develop a next-generation, facility-scale High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) power architecture purpose-built for Generative AI compute loads. This is a greenfield, industry-defining effort — reference designs at this scale and application do not broadly exist in the data center industry. As such, we are seeking engineers with deep domain expertise in high-power HVDC and power conversion systems who bring the intellectual foundation and engineering rigor to translate that expertise into a novel data center context. Direct data center experience is welcomed but is not a prerequisite for this role

You will be responsible for delivery of projects, applying design quality controls, and providing technical guidance to team members. As a subject matter expert, you will be responsible for the design of prototypical DC facilities, localization of conceptual innovations, solving large-scale implementation issues, and building strong relationships with the regional industry. This role represents a rare opportunity to define a new class of data center power infrastructure from the ground up. The successful candidate will not be expected to know all the answers on day one — they will be expected to have the engineering depth, intellectual rigor, and collaborative mindset to help build them.

Anticipated travel: up to 25%

Key job responsibilities

Develop strategic solutions that meet or exceed quality requirements and fall within budgetary and redundancy requirements
Conceive, initiate, and lead projects with widespread impact on infrastructure design, innovation, and implementation
Set the standard for engineering, test, and best practices; drive process improvements across the organization
Decompose complex problems into straightforward and actionable solutions
Be a leader within the group and within internal and external teams that support our data centers
Provide technical oversight of the Regional Electrical and Mechanical Basis of Design (BOD)
Serve as a technical advisor for AWS datacenter electrical and mechanical designs
Work with internal teams to understand user requirements
Work with local agencies having jurisdiction and certification agencies to ensure compliance with federal, state, and municipal requirements and building codes

A day in the life

In this role, you'll lead the technical strategy for data center infrastructure design across your region, working on complex projects that impact how we deliver capacity and innovation globally. You might spend your morning reviewing electrical and mechanical designs with your engineering team, then transition to presenting a business case to leadership on a new cooling technology that could reduce costs without compromising reliability. Later, you could be collaborating with construction teams to solve implementation challenges on an active project, or meeting with local agencies to ensure our designs meet all compliance requirements. You'll also mentor engineers on your team, helping them develop their expertise in mission-critical systems while fostering a culture of creative problem-solving and continuous improvement.

About The Team

We are a global engineering organization dedicated to designing resilient, cost-effective data center facilities that support AWS's rapid growth. Our team includes Architects, Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, and Control Engineers who work collaboratively to challenge conventional thinking and develop innovative solutions. We partner closely with operations, security, field engineering, and construction management teams to ensure our designs are not only technically sound but also practical and implementable. Our vision is to establish design procedures and protocols that set industry standards while meeting the evolving demands of cloud infrastructure. You'll be joining a group that values technical excellence, creative problem-solving, and strong cross-functional relationships with both internal teams and regional industry partners.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Electrical, Mechanical, Structural Engineering or equivalent field
Cumulative 8+ years of experience managing staff focused on mission critical infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

10+ years of experience directly related to data center or mission critical facility engineering.
Professional Engineering License or Master Degree in Engineering
Direct experience with high voltage distribution systems.
Direct experience with chiller systems, cooling towers and factory testing protocols
Managing experience with the construction, operation, or maintenance of data centers.
Previous consultant and jurisdiction negotiation skills associated with construction and project execution.
Experience with large scale technical operations or large-scale compute facilities.

We're experimenting. When you couple that with the ability to work on so many different products and services, it's a very unique learning culture.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at Annapurna Labs, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Are you ready to shape the future of global cloud infrastructure? Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team is seeking a Senior Manager, Software Development to lead multiple engineering teams building mission-critical systems that power AWS's global infrastructure supply chain. Your engineering decisions will directly impact how AWS delivers and operates data centers worldwide, ensuring hundreds of thousands of customers have seamless access to cloud services.

In this role, you'll define the technical vision and engineering culture for teams responsible for core SCos subsystems. You'll balance immediate delivery needs with long-term strategic investments, setting standards for operational excellence while developing the next generation of engineering leaders. If you're passionate about solving complex problems at unprecedented scale, building high-performing teams, and driving innovation that keeps the cloud running, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Key job responsibilities

Lead and develop multiple software development teams, including managing other engineering managers, to deliver scalable infrastructure solutions that support AWS global data center operations
Define and execute the long-term technical strategy, resource planning, and organizational structure for your teams, making critical decisions on hiring, team composition, and succession planning that enable sustainable growth
Establish and drive operational excellence across your organization by implementing mechanisms for monitoring, alarming, incident response, and continuous improvement that ensure high availability and performance
Partner with Principal Engineers, Applied Scientists, and cross-functional stakeholders to align architectural decisions with business objectives and product roadmaps, ensuring solutions meet both current and future needs
Set and balance organizational goals that optimize for customer outcomes, engineering quality, and employee development while fostering an inclusive environment where team members grow their technical and leadership capabilities

A day in the life

You'll start your day reviewing operational metrics across your teams, identifying opportunities to improve system performance and reliability. You'll spend time in technical design reviews, partnering with Principal Engineers to evaluate architectural tradeoffs for new features. Throughout the day, you'll coach your engineering managers on handling team challenges, conduct one-on-ones with senior engineers to support their growth, and facilitate cross-team collaboration sessions. You'll also work on strategic planning documents that shape the multi-year roadmap for SCos, balancing technical innovation with business priorities.

About The Team

The AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team builds the software systems that orchestrate AWS's physical infrastructure supply chain at global scale. Our mission is to ensure AWS data centers have the right equipment, in the right place, at the right time to support customer demand. We work on complex challenges involving inventory management, capacity planning, and deployment automation that directly impact AWS's ability to scale.

Our team values innovation, operational excellence, and continuous learning. We foster an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive better solutions, and we invest heavily in developing our engineers and leaders. As AWS continues its rapid growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud infrastructure while building and leading world-class engineering teams.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Director of Technology to serve as technical leader for our Asia Pacific, Japan, and China (APJC) region. This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of cloud and generative AI adoption across one of the world's most dynamic and strategically significant markets — and to do so as a core member of both the APJC Leadership Team and the AWS Global Technology Leadership Team.

In this role, you will provide the technical leadership and voice within the go-to-market strategy for a region of extraordinary scale, diversity, and complexity. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and cross-functional AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address customers' most pressing business challenges and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. Recognised as a trusted customer advocate, you will help organisations understand best practices for advanced cloud-based solutions — including how to migrate and modernise existing workloads — while translating complex technology into compelling business outcomes.

You will lead a high-performing organisation of Solutions Architects and technical leaders, driving transformational customer outcomes across the region. Your influence will extend well beyond your direct organisation — shaping AWS's technical strategy, contributing to worldwide leadership forums, and serving as a trusted voice at the intersection of technology, business, and innovation. This role demands both the strategic foresight to anticipate where the market is heading and the operational excellence to execute across a matrixed, global organisation.

Key job responsibilities

Regional Technology Strategy & Vision

Influence technical strategy for APJC, aligning to AWS's global priorities while reflecting the unique regulatory environments, cultural nuances, and growth trajectories of markets across the region.
Serve as the primary technology voice for APJC within the Global Technology Leadership Team, influencing decisions on product direction, go-to-market investment, and customer engagement models.
Anticipate emerging technology trends — including generative AI, sovereign cloud, and industry-specific platforms — and position AWS as the partner of choice.

Executive Customer Engagement & Influence

Engage at C-suite and board level with AWS's customers and prospects, serving as a trusted advisor on digital transformation, AI strategy, and cloud-native architecture.
Build and sustain executive relationships that accelerate adoption, deepen partnership, and unlock new categories of customer value across APJC's diverse industries and markets.
Lead the development of compelling, differentiated technical narratives that connect AWS capabilities to customer business priorities — driving pipeline, accelerating deal velocity, and supporting revenue growth.
Represent AWS at major industry events, government engagements, and thought leadership forums across the region.

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development

Lead, inspire, and develop a large, geographically distributed organisation of technical leaders and Solutions Architects, fostering a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous innovation.
Build the next generation of AWS technical leaders through coaching, sponsorship, and structured talent development programmes that reflect the diversity and ambition of the APJC region.
Set the bar for technical credibility and customer impact and establish high standards for operational management — defining goals and metrics, and managing the rhythm of business through weekly, monthly, and annual planning mechanisms.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Global Influence

Partner extensively with APJC Sales, Marketing, Professional Services, and Partner leadership to develop integrated strategies that drive revenue growth and market expansion.
Collaborate with AWS Global Service Teams to ensure APJC customer insights and requirements shape the global product roadmap.
Operate as a senior leader within the APJC Leadership Team, contributing to regional business strategy beyond the technology function.

A day in the life

You are a technology executive with a track record of leading large, complex organizations through periods of significant growth and transformation. You combine deep technical credibility with exceptional business acumen, and you are equally comfortable presenting a generative AI architecture to a CTO and articulating a market investment thesis to a CEO or board.

You Bring

Proven experience leading technical pre-sales or customer-facing technical organisations at scale across diverse, multi-country markets — ideally including experience in APJC or similarly complex international regions.
A strategic mindset that looks beyond technology to the business outcomes it enables — and the ability to translate that vision into executable go-to-market strategy.
Demonstrated success building and developing high-performing, inclusive teams of technical leaders in a fast-moving, matrixed environment.
The ability to foster a culture of innovation, customer-centricity, and continuous learning.
Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence with customers, partners, government stakeholders, and internal leadership at the highest levels.
Deep familiarity with cloud computing, generative AI, and the evolving technology landscape — and the intellectual curiosity to stay ahead of what's next.
Experience operating as a member of a senior leadership team, contributing to business strategy beyond your direct functional remit.
A demonstrated ability to connect technical solutions to commercial outcomes, supporting sales cycles and influencing customer buying decisions at the executive level.

Basic Qualifications

Basic qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
10 + years leadership experience in a technical, customer-facing role within the technology industry
15+ years of design, implementation or consulting experience with cloud native applications and architectures
Extensive people management experience
Exceptional communication skills both verbal and written

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred qualifications:

History of successful technical consulting and/or architecture engagements with large-scale customers or enterprises
Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
Familiarity with common enterprise services or platforms
Track record of presenting and influencing up to C level across technical and non-technical audiences
High degree of comfort communicating effectively across internal and external organizations
Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly
